jobs.title: Head of Retail Excellence
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129783

Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai forged its reputation by developing precision instruments and professional watches for the Royal Italian Navy, renowned for their reliability and functional design. Rooted in performance, purpose, and precision, the Maison embraces its heritage while pushing the boundaries of innovation, combining Italian design with Swiss expertise. Today, Panerai continues to create tool watches that serve as trusted companions for every adventure, even in the most demanding environments.

We are on a mission to elevate our retail performance and cultivate an unyielding culture of excellence across our network. To lead this crucial endeavor, we are seeking a visionary Head of Retail Excellence to join our HQ commercial team.

Your mission

You will be the driving force behind our retail strategies, translating vision into impactful execution on the ground. Your leadership will ensure unparalleled operational excellence, empower our teams through expertly coordinated training, and cultivate extraordinary client experiences by championing best-in-class VIC management.

How will you make an impact?

Strategy & Vision:

• Develop and articulate a comprehensive Retail Excellence strategy aligned with the overall commercial objectives and brand vision.
• Identify key areas for improvement in retail operations, customer experience, and VIC management.

Process Optimization & Standardization:

• Establish and maintain the Retail Excellence framework and associated procedures, ensuring standards, best practices and consistent execution across all network.

Customer Experience Enhancement and focus on our top clients:

• Champion a customer-centric approach, focusing on elevating the end-to-end customer journey.
• Implement tools and methodologies to measure and improve customer satisfaction (e.g., NPS, mystery shopping programs).
• Lead VIC programs, ensuring top-tier client engagement and retention at global level.
• Collaborate with marketing and product teams to ensure a seamless brand experience.

Training & Development:

• Deliver training programs for retail staff on operational procedures, product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer service excellence.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the retail teams.
• Work with HR teams and our training content creator as well as talent teams to ensure talent development and succession planning for key retail roles.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Work closely with Revenue Growth and commercial performance, CRM & Clienteling, SDP & VM teams as well as HR, IT and supply chain departments to ensure integrated and effective retail strategies.
• Act as a liaison between corporate functions and retail operations to facilitate communication and alignment.

Retail Strategic Initiatives:

• Lead and manage projects related to retail innovation, new store openings, store renovations, and technology implementations in line with the Richemont Roadmap.
• Oversee the successful delivery of projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and expected outcomes.

How will you experience success?

• Bachelor’s or master’s Degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in Retail in the luxury or jewelry/watch industry.
• Proven experience in developing and implementing retail strategies and best operational practices across multiple locations.
• Strong understanding of luxury customer expectations and service standards.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
• Excellent PM skills with a track record of successful execution.
• Strong ability to lead, motivate, and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are needed with an emphasis on detail and organization, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges.
• Flexibility to travel.
• Great hands-on mentality and implementation skills.
• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages relevant to Richemont's global presence (e.g., French, Italian,…) is a significant advantage.

What makes Panerai unique?

• Join a dynamic Maison spirit that values and empowers your unique skills and contributions.
• Thrive within enriching communities built on genuine care, continuous improvement, and efficient accountability.
• Collaborate across borders and cultures, gaining invaluable international experience.
• Embark on a fulfilling career journey within Panerai and across the Richemont Group.

Your journey with us

Our recruitment journey is designed to offer insight and enriching exchanges, grounded in transparency, respect and fairness.

The recruitment process includes conversations with the Hiring Manager, key business partners, and members of our executive teams.

Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you.

• Implement tools and methodologies to measure and improve customer satisfaction (e.g., NPS, mystery shopping programs).
• Lead VIC programs, ensuring top-tier client engagement and retention at global level.
• Collaborate with marketing and product teams to ensure a seamless brand experience.

Training & Development:

• Deliver training programs for retail staff on operational procedures, product knowledge, sales techniques, and customer service excellence.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the retail teams.
• Work with HR teams and our training content creator as well as talent teams to ensure talent development and succession planning for key retail roles.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

• Work closely with Revenue Growth and commercial performance, CRM & Clienteling, SDP & VM teams as well as HR, IT and supply chain departments to ensure integrated and effective retail strategies.
• Act as a liaison between corporate functions and retail operations to facilitate communication and alignment.

Retail Strategic Initiatives:

• Lead and manage projects related to retail innovation, new store openings, store renovations, and technology implementations in line with the Richemont Roadmap.
• Oversee the successful delivery of projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities and expected outcomes.

How will you experience success?

• Bachelor’s or master’s Degree and a minimum of 8 years of related experience in Retail in the luxury or jewelry/watch industry.
• Proven experience in developing and implementing retail strategies and best operational practices across multiple locations.
• Strong understanding of luxury customer expectations and service standards.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable strategies.
• Excellent PM skills with a track record of successful execution.
• Strong ability to lead, motivate, and influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders at all levels.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are needed with an emphasis on detail and organization, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
• Proactive and solution-oriented approach to challenges.
• Flexibility to travel.
• Great hands-on mentality and implementation skills.
• Fluency in English is required; proficiency in other languages relevant to Richemont's global presence (e.g., French, Italian,…) is a significant advantage.

What makes Panerai unique?

• Join a dynamic Maison spirit that values and empowers your unique skills and contributions.
• Thrive within enriching communities built on genuine care, continuous improvement, and efficient accountability.
• Collaborate across borders and cultures, gaining invaluable international experience.
• Embark on a fulfilling career journey within Panerai and across the Richemont Group.

Your journey with us

Our recruitment journey is designed to offer insight and enriching exchanges, grounded in transparency, respect and fairness.

The recruitment process includes conversations with the Hiring Manager, key business partners, and members of our executive teams.

Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR129923

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

QUELLE SERA VOTRE CONTRIBUTION ?

En tant que membre de notre équipe R&I Electronic Systems & Solutions (E2S), vous serez le chef d'orchestre de projets complexes et impactants :

Pilotage de projets d'innovation :

•

Mener le cadrage, la planification et le suivi de projets R&I stratégiques, depuis la phase d'étude exploratoire jusqu'au transfert de technologie.

Définir et gérer les objectifs, les livrables, les plannings et les risques, en vous appuyant sur des méthodologies Agile et Prince2.

Coordonner et animer les équipes techniques, les partenaires internes (Manufactures, Maisons) et externes, garantissant une collaboration fluide et efficace.

Assurer la rédaction et la formalisation de la documentation projet à chaque étape clé.

Expertise technique Firmware & Ultra Low Power :

Concevoir et déployer des architectures logicielles embarquées robustes et évolutives, capables de supporter le développement de nos produits.

Développer des preuves de concept (POC) et prototypes, avec une approche système intégrée (hardware, software, mécanique).

Implémenter et valider des firmwares performants en C, C++ et Python, avec une expertise reconnue sur les microcontrôleurs STM32 et une connaissance des EFR32.

Maîtriser l'optimisation de puissance à un niveau micro-ampère et nano-ampère, en gérant finement les modes de veille, l'utilisation du MCU et les périphériques pour atteindre des consommations ultra-faibles.

Intégrer et piloter des capteurs complexes via des interfaces comme SPI, I2C, BLE, NFC et des techniques de bitbang.

Mettre en œuvre des pratiques de développement rigoureuses, incluant l'utilisation de GIT pour le contrôle de versions, le débogage embarqué et le JTAG.

Veille technologique & Innovation :

Être force de proposition sur les technologies, concepts et axes de développement innovants qui soutiennent la stratégie R&I du Groupe.

Assurer une veille technologique active sur les dernières avancées en systèmes embarqués, microélectronique et gestion de l'énergie.

Support à l'industrialisation :

Apporter un support technique expert aux Manufactures et Maisons lors du passage en production et garantir la qualité et la robustesse des solutions déployées.

QUELLES SONT LES CLÉS DE VOTRE RÉUSSITE ?

Ingénieur.e en électronique, systèmes embarqués, microtechnique ou équivalent.

Vous justifiez d'une première expérience significative (3 à 5 ans) en développement firmware et en gestion de projets techniques complexes, avec une expertise reconnue en ultra-basse consommation.

Compétences techniques :

Maîtrise approfondie des langages C et Python.

Expertise en architecture logicielle embarquée et capacité à concevoir des solutions évolutives.

Connaissance avérée des microcontrôleurs STM32 et une familiarité avec les EFR32.

Compétence primordiale en optimisation énergétique pour des applications ultra-low power (cibles nA/µA).

Connaissance des interfaces de communication (SPI, I2C, BLE, NFC, bitbang).

Pratique de l'intégration de capteurs.

Maîtrise des outils de gestion de version comme GIT.

Expérience en débogage embarqué et utilisation de JTAG.

Expérience en gestion de projet ; connaissance des méthodologies Agile (Scrum, Kanban) et Prince2, un plus.

Doté.e d'une forte autonomie, d'un sens aigu de l'organisation et d'excellentes capacités de communication, vous savez fédérer des équipes, prendre des initiatives et résoudre des problèmes complexes avec rigueur et esprit d'analyse. Vous êtes proactif.ve dans l'exploration et l'adoption d'outils innovants, y compris ceux basés sur l'Intelligence Artificielle, pour améliorer l'efficacité du développement.

Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral et à l'écrit.

Le poste est basé principalement à Buttes, au cœur de notre laboratoire d’innovation, avec une présence régulière dans notre hub R&I de Neuchâtel pour favoriser les échanges d’équipe et les synergies. Nous offrons un cadre de travail souple et équilibré grâce à des horaires de travail flexibles et la possibilité d’une journée de télétravail par semaine.

Il s'agit d'un poste d’une durée de 12 mois, avec possibilité de renouvellement.

VOTRE EXPÉRIENCE CANDIDAT AVEC NOUS

Si votre candidature est retenue, nous vous inviterons pour une entrevue dans nos locaux avec le Responsable du Pôle et le HR Business Partner. Dans un deuxième temps, nous vous soumettrons un cas pratique à réaliser et venir présenter devant un parterre d’experts.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: New Foundations Scope & Simplification Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130030

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

YOUR MISSION:

New Foundations is Richemont’s multi-year transformation programme to simplify and align business processes and technology in preparation for the Group’s migration to SAP S/4HANA. It is designed to create the organisational, governance and delivery foundations needed to enable a successful, scalable and business-led ERP transformation.

As Scope and Simplification Manager for New Foundations, you will drive business process transformation and configuration simplification across the programme, ensuring scope decisions are grounded in business impact, value and transformation readiness. Working in close partnership with the organisation and reporting to Programme Director, you will leverage your SAP S/4HANA expertise to bridge the gap between Richemont’s current operations and its future-state processes, functionalities and configuration — acting as the guardian of simplicity, harmonisation and clean-core discipline.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

In this role, you will:

•

Own the assessment of current business processes and configuration against SAP S/4HANA standards, identifying transformation opportunities, business impacts and change efforts.

Orchestrate the work of Business Process Managers (BPMs) and functional teams to map, challenge and optimise end-to-end processes, ensuring process ownership stays with the business.

Lead simplification initiatives across processes and custom code, looking to standardise, harmonise or carry forward based on business value and operational impact.

Frame keep / adapt / retire decisions through a business-value lens to right-size the ERP.

Assess the business impact of scope decisions, ensuring the organisation understands the changes, operational consequences and transformation readiness.

Work to upskill the organization on SAP S/4HANA processes and standard functionalities, building functional fluency across business teams.

Work closely with the ECC Functional Expert to anchor recommendations in the reality of the current landscape, surfacing constraints, risks and dependencies.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Experience with SAP S/4HANA programmes and transformations.

Proven track record in process simplification or standardisation in complex environments.

Strong exposure to end-to-end business processes (for example Finance, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash).

Comfortable engaging with senior business and Senior Technology leaders.

Experience operating in Group, multi-entity or multi-brand environments.

Skilled at translating business requirements into standard, scalable SAP S/4HANA outcomes.

Deep understanding of SAP S/4HANA standard processes, clean-core principles and, where possible, the ECC landscape.

Solid process modelling and documentation capability and experience.

Analytical rigour to frame keep / adapt / retire decisions with clear trade-offs.

Ability to distil complexity into actionable scope and simplification options.

Effective stakeholder communication across senior business and technology audiences.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity.

We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity.

We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

Our recruitment journey for this role is designed to be respectful, transparent and grounded in genuine dialogue. You can typically expect:

An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss your background, motivations and the role.

A meeting with Hiring Manager and HR for this role.

Subsequent interviews with key Group Platforms stakeholders and members of the New Foundations programme team to explore your experience in depth.

A final conversation focused on mutual fit, expectations and next steps.

We are committed to providing timely, transparent feedback at each stage of the process.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Reference code: JR130031

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

YOUR MISSION:

New Foundations is Richemont’s multi-year transformation programme to simplify and align business processes and technology in preparation for the Group’s migration to SAP S/4HANA. It is designed to create the organisational, governance and delivery foundations needed to enable a successful, scalable and business-led ERP transformation.

As Technical Manager for New Foundations, you will own the target technology architecture and shape the technology evolution path required to deliver Richemont’s SAP S/4HANA migration. You will ensure that the adoption decisions made through scope and simplification translate into a coherent, future-proof and sustainable enterprise landscape, extending well beyond the conversion event itself. Working under the Programme Director, you will collaborate with technology experts to define the migration roadmap with Group Platforms and guide the evolution of the ERP landscape across the programme lifecycle.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

In this role, you will:

•

Own the target-state technology architecture and define the future SAP S/4HANA-centred landscape — ERP core, satellites, integrations and extensions on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) and third-party platforms.

Translate scope and simplification decisions into a viable and scalable architecture blueprint, aligned with Group architecture principles and clean-core strategy.

Define clear ERP boundaries, ensuring consistency between what is removed or simplified and what is rebuilt, extended or externalised.

Own the integration and extensibility strategy, including application programming interfaces (APIs), middleware and event-driven patterns.

Assess technical feasibility, dependencies and sequencing, anchoring ambition in technical reality.

Prepare technology principles, architecture guardrails and the inputs required for Solution Design.

Partner with product and technical teams to upskill on SAP S/4HANA and ensure decisions are grounded in technical reality.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Senior experience in large-scale ERP and platform transformations (SAP S/4HANA is a must).

Proven track record in Technical Architecture in complex environments.

Deep experience designing hybrid landscapes (ERP, satellites, data, integrations, cloud platforms).

Comfortable engaging with senior technology and business leaders, including ExCo-level forums.

Experience operating in an international multi-entity or multi-brand environments.

Strong mastery of SAP S/4HANA architecture patterns, clean-core principles and extensibility models.

Deep understanding of integration architectures, APIs, middleware and SAP BTP.

Ability to translate simplification and legacy constraints into forward-looking architecture choices.

Strong analytical capability to frame technology trade-offs (standard vs flexibility vs cost).

Structured decision framing, with a focus on long-term operability and scalability.

Strong long-term and systems thinking.

Comfortable holding the line on architectural non-negotiables.

Credible authority with both technology and business stakeholders.

Acts as a steward of future value, not a defender of current solutions.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT ?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity.

jobs.title: Constructeur Mouvement (H/F)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130111

Since MONTBLANC revolutionized writing culture in 1906 with the first spill-proof fountain pen, we have been known for outstanding craftsmanship, highest aesthetics, and innovative solutions. And we keep pushing the boundaries. We combine the best of tradition, technology and design in writing instruments, watches, leather goods, new technologies and selected accessories. With our name and in our emblem, we embody this mission: to implement bold ideas with outstanding craftsmanship and create refined products for people with highest expectations. In doing so, we are at the forefront of technology and design, drawing on the passion of more than 3,000 employees and living a culture that - like our products - inspires people to unleash their potential, to thrive and to achieve.

Responsabilités Principales :
1. Conception et Développement :
• Concevoir et développer des mouvements horlogers mécaniques en utilisant des logiciels de CAO 2D et 3D PTC Creo et Tellwatch
• Réaliser les études de faisabilité technique et les analyses fonctionnelles des nouveaux mouvements ou des évolutions de mouvements existants.
• Définir les architectures mécaniques, les cinématiques et les tolérances dimensionnelles des composants.
• Intégrer les contraintes esthétiques, techniques, de coût et de production dès la phase de conception

2. Collaboration avec l’industrialisation et Prototypage :
• Établir les dossiers techniques complets (plans de fabrication, nomenclatures, spécifications techniques) pour le prototypage et la production.
• Collaborer avec l'atelier de prototypage et le chef de projet pour la réalisation des premières pièces et l'assemblage des mouvements.
• Participer aux phases de tests et de validation des prototypes, analyser les résultats et proposer des améliorations.
• Assurer le suivi technique lors de la phase d'industrialisation et de mise en production en série.

3. Optimisation et Amélioration Continue :
• Rechercher et proposer des solutions innovantes pour améliorer la performance, la fiabilité, la précision et la facilité d'assemblage des mouvements.
• Optimiser les coûts de fabrication sans compromettre la qualité.

4. Collaboration et Communication :
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les designers, les horlogers, les méthodes, les chefs de projets et les équipes de production.
• Présenter les avancées techniques et les solutions aux équipes internes et à la direction.
• Participer aux revues de projet et aux réunions techniques.

Qualifications Requises :
• Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur en microtechnique orientation horlogerie ou titre jugé équivalent
• Expérience : Minimum 5 années d'expérience significative dans la conception et le développement de mouvements horlogers complexes, idéalement au sein d'une manufacture de haute horlogerie.

Compétences Techniques :
• Maîtrise approfondie des principes de la mécanique horlogère et des complications.
• Expertise des logiciels PTC Creo et Windchill
• Connaissance des matériaux horlogers et des procédés de fabrication (usinage, découpe, traitement de surface, etc.).
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des plans techniques complexes.
• Connaissance des normes et standards de l'industrie horlogère.
• Langues : Maîtrise du français

Qualités Personnelles :
• Rigueur, précision et souci du détail.
• Créativité et esprit d'innovation.
• Capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes complexes.
• Autonomie et proactivité.
• Excellent esprit d'équipe et aptitudes à la communication.
• Passion pour l'horlogerie et la mécanique de précision.

• Présenter les avancées techniques et les solutions aux équipes internes et à la direction.
• Participer aux revues de projet et aux réunions techniques.

Qualifications Requises :
• Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur en microtechnique orientation horlogerie ou titre jugé équivalent
• Expérience : Minimum 5 années d'expérience significative dans la conception et le développement de mouvements horlogers complexes, idéalement au sein d'une manufacture de haute horlogerie.

Compétences Techniques :
• Maîtrise approfondie des principes de la mécanique horlogère et des complications.
• Expertise des logiciels PTC Creo et Windchill
• Connaissance des matériaux horlogers et des procédés de fabrication (usinage, découpe, traitement de surface, etc.).
• Capacité à lire et interpréter des plans techniques complexes.
• Connaissance des normes et standards de l'industrie horlogère.
• Langues : Maîtrise du français

Qualités Personnelles :
• Rigueur, précision et souci du détail.
• Créativité et esprit d'innovation.

• Excellent esprit d'équipe et aptitudes à la communication.

With our name and in our emblem, we embody this mission: to implement bold ideas with outstanding craftsmanship and create refined products for people with highest expectations. jobs.title: Anaplan Model Builder
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130201
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

As one of the core building block of the Cartier Data Office, Connected Planning is a critical, yet rapidly expending part of our Data ecosystem.

The Anaplan model builder has a key role in the development of the solution within the Maison and the maintenance of the models ensuring operational efficiency and business continuity. As a model builder, you will ensure that models used Maison-wide are matching industry standard best practices and delivering the best level of performance and robustness.

How will you make an impact?

You will have the following responsibilities:

• Model building
• Implement best practices for model development, including version control, documentation and technical optimizations.
• Proactively keep a high level of technical expertise, and stay up to date with latest developments of the Solution.
• Ensure robustness and perennity of the models. Ensure data integrity, accuracy and reliability within the models.
• Maintain comprehensive documentation including design specifications, formulas, and assumptions.
• Maintenance
• Investigate and resolve issues related to Anaplan models, including data inconsistencies, formula errors, and system performance. Provide support to end-users.
• New projects
• Collaborate with business stakeholders from different department of the Maison.
• Work with project teams to understand their challenges and requirements. Translate them into scalable and efficient Anaplan models.
• Supporting new projects from the beginning to a successful launch.
• Collaborate and federate
• Facilitate the exchanges of experience and best practices among domains, while evaluating the appropriate help based on their specific needs.
• Actively contribute to the Anaplan community by sharing knowledge, collaborating on projects and driving innovation.

Your profile

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Management, or a related field.
• Proven experience as an Anaplan Model builder and Anaplan Model builder certification are a must. Anaplan Solution Architect certification is a plus.
• Experience in Supply Chain
• Experience working with Agile methodologies and management tools (e.g. Jira).
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Understanding of supply chain processes is a plus.
• English and French.

How do we keep you smiling?

You will play an active role into our Transformation journey, working on solutions that individually generate immediate value, but that collectively enrich our data platform, opening the door to further value creation.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Planning Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130200
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

End of studies internship with school agreement

Duration: 6 months minimum

Location: 1752 Villars-sur-Glâne, Switzerland

Context:

The objective of this internship is to enrich your academic background with a stimulating professional experience in an international environment.

How will you make an impact?

In our Supply Chain department in charge of the distribution of finished goods, you will be part of a highly established team and you will contribute to the following missions:

Carry out business analysis for the definition and implementation of the supply strategy to ensure optimum stock level, challenge forecast and loops with all stakeholders,

Collaborate with markets, marketing and external supplier on their problematics,

Create reporting and maintain existing reports, particularly under Power BI or Anaplan

Participate in continuous improvement projects related to the department activity

Your profile

You are in your last year master’s degree in engineering with a Supply Chain focus.

You have advanced skills in Excel and/or experience with Power BI.

You have robust analytical skills, and you easily analyze and work with Data and Information Systems.

You are organized, autonomous and reliable.

You have a very good command of French and English.

How do we keep you smiling?

You will be a part of a dynamic and international work environment, where we always go the extra mile to uphold outstanding service for our clients

Your journey with us

If your application is selected, we will reach out to you ASAP for an informal introductory call. The next step will be an introductory call with one of our Data Scientists, followed by a technical interview and a business case.

jobs.title: Store Planning and Construction Project Manager – Europe

titleByLocale.en: Store Planning and Construction Project Manager – Europe
titleByLocale.it: Store Planning and Construction Project Manager – Europe
titleByLocale.de: Store Planning and Construction Project Manager – Europe
titleByLocale.fr: Store Planning and Construction Project Manager – Europe

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130767

Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura.

Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations.
Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation.

Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

As a Store Planning and Construction Project Manager, you will spearhead the full lifecycle of Piaget's retail development projects across the Europe Region, from design to post-opening. This pivotal role, blending Headquarters and regional responsibilities, ensures both Brand desirability through design excellence and Brand productivity via operational efficiency, quality, cost control, and sustainability. You will be instrumental in delivering the region's retail development and renovation program, upholding brand desirability, execution quality, project planning, budget, and sustainability commitments. Regular travel across France, Switzerland, Italy, and Nordics is essential for site assessments and project oversight.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design:

• Coordinate design development from concept to construction documentation, ensuring consistency with Piaget's architectural standards and Brand identity.
• Manage external design specialists (architects, 3D artists, consultants).
• Collaborate with HQ Retail, VM, and Commercial teams to optimize retail experience and operational efficiency.

Budgeting, Planning & Construction:

• Lead projects from investment validation through construction and close-out, developing and controlling budgets, CAPEX, and planning.
• Drive tendering, technical evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract awards.
• Manage procurement, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, and financial reporting.
• Coordinate permitting, landlord approvals, and local authority relations.
• Act as a key stakeholder with Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, and external partners throughout the project.
• Manage all construction phases, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to Piaget's quality and sustainability standards.

Risk Management:

• Identify project risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans.

Maintenance:

• Coordinate regional maintenance and post-opening programs, including snagging, retrofit projects, and minor works.
• Maintain regular communication with Commercial teams and Boutique Directors across Europe.
• Ensure compliance with Piaget Brand standards, quality, and sustainability objectives.

Transversal Management:

• Act as the primary HQ interface for the Europe Region, coordinating Regional Markets for boutique construction and maintenance.
• Collaborate closely with internal teams (Retail, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Finance, Security, VM, Content) and develop strong relationships with external partners (landlords, consultants, contractors).

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Experience:

• Minimum 10 years in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or Construction Project Management, with at least 7 years specifically in luxury Store Planning and Construction.
• Proven track record delivering international retail projects within the luxury industry or premium brands.
• Solid understanding of luxury design, construction processes, and operational excellence.
• Extensive experience managing Executive Architects, Quantity Surveyors, General Contractors, and specialist consultants.
• Strong knowledge of procurement, tender management, commercial negotiations, and cost control.

Technical Competencies:

• Exceptional analytical, planning, and project management skills.
• Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities.
• Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and advanced Microsoft Office Suite knowledge.
• Professional fluency in English and French is essential; additional languages are a significant asset.
• Strong commercial awareness, proven negotiation skills, and construction cost expertise.

Soft Skills:

• Creative, solution-oriented, and passionate about luxury retail environments, architecture, and design trends.
• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, effective in multicultural teams.
• Agile, adaptable, and adept at managing changing priorities and complex stakeholder landscapes.
• Strong decision-maker with a high sense of ownership, accountability, and a results-oriented, continuous improvement mindset.
• Highly organized, proactive, and capable of simultaneously managing multiple strategic projects.

STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY?

• A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference.

Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura.

Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations.
Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation.

Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

As a Store Planning and Construction Project Manager, you will spearhead the full lifecycle of Piaget's retail development projects across the Europe Region, from design to post-opening. This pivotal role, blending Headquarters and regional responsibilities, ensures both Brand desirability through design excellence and Brand productivity via operational efficiency, quality, cost control, and sustainability. You will be instrumental in delivering the region's retail development and renovation program, upholding brand desirability, execution quality, project planning, budget, and sustainability commitments. Regular travel across France, Switzerland, Italy, and Nordics is essential for site assessments and project oversight.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design:

• Coordinate design development from concept to construction documentation, ensuring consistency with Piaget's architectural standards and Brand identity.
• Manage external design specialists (architects, 3D artists, consultants).
• Collaborate with HQ Retail, VM, and Commercial teams to optimize retail experience and operational efficiency.

Budgeting, Planning & Construction:

• Lead projects from investment validation through construction and close-out, developing and controlling budgets, CAPEX, and planning.
• Drive tendering, technical evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract awards.
• Manage procurement, Purchase Orders, Change Orders, and financial reporting.
• Coordinate permitting, landlord approvals, and local authority relations.
• Act as a key stakeholder with Group Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, and external partners throughout the project.
• Manage all construction phases, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to Piaget's quality and sustainability standards.

Risk Management:

• Identify project risks and implement mitigation and recovery plans.

Maintenance:

• Coordinate regional maintenance and post-opening programs, including snagging, retrofit projects, and minor works.
• Maintain regular communication with Commercial teams and Boutique Directors across Europe.
• Ensure compliance with Piaget Brand standards, quality, and sustainability objectives.

Transversal Management:

• Act as the primary HQ interface for the Europe Region, coordinating Regional Markets for boutique construction and maintenance.
• Collaborate closely with internal teams (Retail, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Finance, Security, VM, Content) and develop strong relationships with external partners (landlords, consultants, contractors).

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Experience:

• Minimum 10 years in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or Construction Project Management, with at least 7 years specifically in luxury Store Planning and Construction.
• Proven track record delivering international retail projects within the luxury industry or premium brands.
• Solid understanding of luxury design, construction processes, and operational excellence.
• Extensive experience managing Executive Architects, Quantity Surveyors, General Contractors, and specialist consultants.
• Strong knowledge of procurement, tender management, commercial negotiations, and cost control.

Technical Competencies:

• Exceptional analytical, planning, and project management skills.
• Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities.
• Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and advanced Microsoft Office Suite knowledge.

• Strong commercial awareness, proven negotiation skills, and construction cost expertise.

• Highly organized, proactive, and capable of simultaneously managing multiple strategic projects.

jobs.title: Swiss Talent Acquisition Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130713

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

Recruitment

• Manage the end-to-end recruitment of interns across our various sites in Switzerland, covering all business functions.
• ⁠Partner closely with hiring managers from role briefing through candidate selection, interviews, offers, and hiring.
• ⁠Identify and leverage the most effective sourcing channels based on business needs, location, and hiring volume.
• ⁠Define relevant selection criteria tailored to each area of recruitment.
• ⁠Analyze recurring hiring needs and anticipate recruitment cycles across business functions to build proactive talent pipelines.

Early Career

• Coordinate and represent the Group at career fairs, networking events, and employer branding initiatives with partner schools and universities.
• Participate in end-of-internship evaluations and ensure effective follow-up with early-career candidates.
• Design and continuously enhance the candidate experience for early talent before, during, and after their internship.
• ⁠Contribute to the continuous improvement and implementation of the Group’s Early Career strategy and related initiatives.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• Final year Bachelor or Master's student in HR, Business Administration or related.
• Currently have an internship agreement (convention) with your school or university.
• Proficiency in office tools, specifically handling datas with Excel and comfortable with Powerpoint (MS Office Suite).
• A first experience in HR, ideally in recruitment or project management, is a strong asset.
• Knowledge of an ATS, ideally Workday, is a plus
• Fluent in French and English (spoken and written).
• Available for a 6-month internship.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

• We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity.
• We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity.
• We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

If your application is selected, you will be invited for a first round of interview with the Talent Acquisition Partners, then a second round with the Swiss Early Careers & Campus Manager.

Finally you will meet with the Head of Swiss Talent.

jobs.title: China Affairs & Strategy Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130726

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

WE RECRUIT

Within Richemont group, Richemont China Affairs & Strategy department has proven to be an effective asset in the development of the relations between various Chinese organizations, Richemont and its Maisons. The department dedicates to providing not only strategic insight and advice as an intelligence desk, but also operational support to all the Maisons of Richemont, and high-level representation of Richemont towards trade and official Chinese partners. Richemont China Affairs & Strategy department is looking for a proactive and business operation competent China Affairs Intern.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

Research and Analysis

• Assist our team to provide analytical insights on macro-economy and consumer market to the Group and Maisons
• Monitor Chinese domestic and overseas markets for information on Chinese travellers & local Chinese communities
• Prepare accurate presentation material to deliver research insights in a comprehensive manner effectively
• Compile information for ad-hoc topics according to Richemont Group’s & Maisons’ requests

Operational Support

• Support the planning, follow-up, and execution of Department’s business operation projects worldwide
• Help the team to identify, explore, and establish contact with prospective business partners and clients for the Maisons’ business
• Assist our team in maintaining and strengthening relationship with existing business partners and Richemont Maisons

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• Student with « convention de stage »
• 1-2 years of work experience in project management/market research/business development
• Good knowledge of macro/micro-economy and geopolitics, as well as the luxury industry
• Impeccable analytical skills for editorial and research purposes
• Proven capability to handle multiple priorities and to work in a dynamic, constantly changing field
• Good interpersonal skills; ability to handle problematic issues and balance multiple interlocutors and projects
• Fluency in English and Chinese is mandatory, fluency in French is a plus
• Prior experience in luxury sector or high-net-worth audience-facing businesses is a plus

titleByLocale.en: Store Design and Planning Project Manager - HQ
titleByLocale.it: Store Design and Planning Project Manager - HQ
titleByLocale.de: Store Design and Planning Project Manager - HQ
titleByLocale.fr: Store Design and Planning Project Manager - HQ

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130768

Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura.

Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations.
Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation.

Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

As a Store Design and Planning Project Manager, you will be the architectural heart of Piaget's global retail network. This pivotal role combines your architectural creativity with strategic project leadership, driving design excellence, innovation, and consistent implementation of Piaget’s retail concept worldwide. You will guide regional project managers, ensuring every flagship, boutique, and shop-in-shop embodies our brand's architectural standards and delivers an unparalleled client experience. Prepare for regular international travel to shape our most prestigious projects.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design Development:

• Lead end-to-end design for Piaget Flagships, Boutiques, and Shop-in-Shops, from concept to approval.
• Ensure designs embody Piaget’s luxury identity, brand DNA, and deliver innovative client experiences.
• Manage external design specialists (architects, lighting, 3D artists).
• Oversee review of layouts, materials, mock-ups, and documentation.
• Collaborate closely with internal Retail, VM, Marketing, Product, and Client Experience teams.

HQ Design Governance & Brand Desirability:

• Serve as HQ Design Authority for your region, guiding Regional Project Managers.
• Validate architectural proposals and shop drawings, ensuring adherence to Piaget’s WW Store Design Guidelines.
• Support regional teams in tendering, Value Engineering, and construction to protect design intent.
• Drive continuous evolution of Piaget’s retail concept, design standards, and technical guidelines.
• Lead aesthetic maintenance and minor works for boutiques across their lifecycle.

Project Leadership:

• Lead strategic flagship and retail projects from concept through design validation.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary consultants throughout the design process.
• Provide design-centric review of project planning, budgets, and Value Engineering.
• Present designs at key Boutique Design Committee meetings and reviews.
• Champion innovation, prototyping, and concept validation for future retail.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement:

• Research and integrate cutting-edge architectural trends, luxury retail concepts, materials, and technologies.
• Promote sustainable design solutions and innovative construction methods.
• Develop new design details, furniture solutions, and retail standards.

Transversal Management:

• Foster strong cross-functional collaboration with internal Retail, Partner Network, VM, and Content teams.
• Build strategic relationships with external consultants, contractors, and partners.
• Share best practices to continuously improve Store Planning processes and technical standards.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Experience:

• Minimum 10 years in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or Retail Design, with at least 7 years specifically in luxury Store Design and Planning.
• Proven track record leading flagship retail projects and premium architectural developments within luxury or international premium brands.
• Deep understanding of retail design development, construction detailing, and luxury client experience.
• Demonstrated ability to coordinate multidisciplinary international teams and external consultants.

Technical Competencies:

• Exceptional architectural design, space planning, and project management capabilities.
• Outstanding presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
• Professional fluency in English and French is essential; additional languages are a plus.

Soft Skills:

• Highly creative with a strong sensitivity to luxury architecture and craftsmanship, capable of transforming concepts into exceptional retail experiences.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills, thriving in multicultural environments.
• Strong leadership, coordination, and ownership, inspiring and guiding regional teams.
• Curious, innovative, and proactive, continuously seeking new architectural inspirations and managing multiple strategic projects simultaneously.
• Collaborative, agile, and committed to continuous improvement.

STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY?

• A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference.
• Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated.
• Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career.

The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply!

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Reference code: JR130768

Surrounded by his family and guided by his strong entrepreneurial mindset, Georges-Edouard Piaget decided, in 1874, to create a watchmaking workshop in La Côte-aux-Fées, a small village in the middle of the Swiss mountains of the Jura.

Since that day, Piaget has pushed the limits to “do what has never been done before” and crafts sophisticated and flamboyant watches and jewellery creations.
Within the walls of our Ateliers de l’Extraordinaire, our master artisans continue to harness rare skills that have been preserved and perfected from generation to generation.

Today, Piaget’s exceptional craftsmanship is celebrated worldwide, supported by a strong global presence and a dedicated network of client support and retail colleagues who bring the spirit of our Maison to life every day.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

As a Store Design and Planning Project Manager, you will be the architectural heart of Piaget's global retail network. This pivotal role combines your architectural creativity with strategic project leadership, driving design excellence, innovation, and consistent implementation of Piaget’s retail concept worldwide. You will guide regional project managers, ensuring every flagship, boutique, and shop-in-shop embodies our brand's architectural standards and delivers an unparalleled client experience. Prepare for regular international travel to shape our most prestigious projects.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design Development:

• Lead end-to-end design for Piaget Flagships, Boutiques, and Shop-in-Shops, from concept to approval.
• Ensure designs embody Piaget’s luxury identity, brand DNA, and deliver innovative client experiences.
• Manage external design specialists (architects, lighting, 3D artists).
• Oversee review of layouts, materials, mock-ups, and documentation.
• Collaborate closely with internal Retail, VM, Marketing, Product, and Client Experience teams.

HQ Design Governance & Brand Desirability:

• Serve as HQ Design Authority for your region, guiding Regional Project Managers.
• Validate architectural proposals and shop drawings, ensuring adherence to Piaget’s WW Store Design Guidelines.
• Support regional teams in tendering, Value Engineering, and construction to protect design intent.
• Drive continuous evolution of Piaget’s retail concept, design standards, and technical guidelines.
• Lead aesthetic maintenance and minor works for boutiques across their lifecycle.

Project Leadership:

• Lead strategic flagship and retail projects from concept through design validation.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary consultants throughout the design process.
• Provide design-centric review of project planning, budgets, and Value Engineering.
• Present designs at key Boutique Design Committee meetings and reviews.
• Champion innovation, prototyping, and concept validation for future retail.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement:

• Research and integrate cutting-edge architectural trends, luxury retail concepts, materials, and technologies.
• Promote sustainable design solutions and innovative construction methods.
• Develop new design details, furniture solutions, and retail standards.

Transversal Management:

• Foster strong cross-functional collaboration with internal Retail, Partner Network, VM, and Content teams.
• Build strategic relationships with external consultants, contractors, and partners.
• Share best practices to continuously improve Store Planning processes and technical standards.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Experience:

• Minimum 10 years in Architecture, Interior Architecture, or Retail Design, with at least 7 years specifically in luxury Store Design and Planning.
• Proven track record leading flagship retail projects and premium architectural developments within luxury or international premium brands.
• Deep understanding of retail design development, construction detailing, and luxury client experience.
• Demonstrated ability to coordinate multidisciplinary international teams and external consultants.

Technical Competencies:

• Exceptional architectural design, space planning, and project management capabilities.
• Outstanding presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
• Professional fluency in English and French is essential; additional languages are a plus.

Soft Skills:

• Highly creative with a strong sensitivity to luxury architecture and craftsmanship, capable of transforming concepts into exceptional retail experiences.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills, thriving in multicultural environments.
• Strong leadership, coordination, and ownership, inspiring and guiding regional teams.
• Curious, innovative, and proactive, continuously seeking new architectural inspirations and managing multiple strategic projects simultaneously.
• Collaborative, agile, and committed to continuous improvement.

STILL WONDERING WHY YOU SHOULD APPLY?

• A Welcoming Team: Join our friendly, open-minded, and talented team, where your skills will be valued and your contributions will make a real difference.
• Dynamic and Engaging Work: Experience daily activities that are interesting, challenging, and diverse, keeping you engaged and motivated.
• Investment in Your Growth: We are passionate about developing our people, and you will have access to various training and development opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career.

The Piaget culture of encouraging Extra-Care, fostering Mastery and bringing out the Extraordinary in our people, means that we will always go further, doing “what has never been done before”. Together. If you want to become a part of it do not hesitate to apply!

jobs.title: Senior Anaplan Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130985

Who are we?

A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment.

Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself.

At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that diverse perspectives foster creativity and knowledge to deliver excellence.

Correspondez-vous au profil ?

Vous êtes fort(e) d’une solide expérience sur des enjeux d’architecture/model bulding de solutions de planning.
Vous maitrisez parfaitement Anaplan et avez une forte sensibilité fonctionnelle.

Vous êtes orienté(e) projet – méthodes agile et cycles en V.

Curieux(se) et force de proposition, vous agissez dans une optique d’amélioration et de recherche de la solution optimale.

Vous êtes doté(e) d’excellentes aptitudes relationnelles afin d’évoluer avec de nombreuses équipes en transverse.

Vous êtes force de proposition et de persuasion afin de conseiller efficacement les équipes.

Vous êtes organisé(e) et faites preuve de rigueur.

Analytique, vous êtes à l’aise avec les chiffres.

Vous êtes agile et autonome.
Vous maitrisez l’anglais.

Si tel est le cas, n’hésitez pas à postuler !

Qu’attendons-nous de vous ?

Au sein du département Technology & Data et rattaché(e) au Senior Manager Data Enablement & Planning Systems, vous êtes en charge de la mise en œuvre de projets Anaplan transverses pour la Maison. Vous intervenez depuis l’expression du besoin jusqu’au support post go-live. Vous animez, développez et faites évoluer les applications Anaplan.

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions :

• Vous assurez le bon déroulement des projets Anaplan, depuis les phases de cadrage jusqu’au déploiement des applications ainsi que la gestion et planification budgétaire.
• Vous êtes le/la garant(e) de l’adéquation des solutions proposées par rapport aux besoins des Métiers et de la stratégie de la Maison.
• Vous agissez en véritable ambassadeur de la fonction et assurez une collaboration étroite entre les équipes internes et externes.
• Vous participez à la réalisation et au développement des projets Anaplan (conception des modules Anaplan, définition de l’architecture technique, développement d’interactions entre les différents modules, qualité des flux de données…).
• Vous assistez les utilisateurs dans les phases de tests.
• Vous garantissez le maintien et l’évolution de la roadmap Anaplan de la Maison en la faisant évoluer, en animant la communauté Anaplan de la Maison et en instaurant une veille technologique.
• Vous avez la responsabilité de gérer une équipe d’intégrateurs externe.

Plus que pour un poste… nous recrutons pour une carrière !

Intégrer la Maison Van Cleef & Arpels, c’est avant tout rejoindre une équipe où le développement des collaborateurs est au cœur de notre ambition.

Vous bénéficierez d’une intégration complète avec des formations sur notre histoire, nos savoir-faire et créations, et un accompagnement au quotidien.

Le processus de recrutement

Postulez directement en ligne

Si votre profil est sélectionné, vous êtes contacté(e) par l’équipe RH pour un entretien.

Vous rencontrez ensuite par étape, le Senior Manager Data Enablement & Planning puis le Directeur Data.

Le cas échéant, vous recevez un email vous informant du refus de votre candidature.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Amélioration continue
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130818

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

CONTEXT
Richemont International Distribution recrute pour son centre de distribution de Genève, un Expert High End Processus Import & Export.

COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ?

Vos missions principales seront les suivantes :

• Définir les processus opérationnels Import et Export
• Assurer le respect de ces processus
• Servir d'interlocuteur référent opérationnel pour le traitement et la résolution des problèmes de processus/procédures
• Mettre en place des solutions d’évolution adaptées, en accord avec la stratégie et l’organisation logistique
• Former et accompagner les équipes Import & Export aux processus opérationnels et à leurs procédures
• Participer et/ou animer des projets et ateliers de travail liés au domaine d’expertise

COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS REUSSIR AVEC NOUS ?

Titulaire d'une formation supérieure en Gestion de Projet, et/ou en méthodes, processus, vous justifiez d'une expertise confirmée des processus d'Importation et d'Exportation, ainsi que de 4 à 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement international et multiculturel.

Rigoureux, organisé et autonome, vous avez une bonne résistance au stress et êtes capable de comprendre/anticiper les problèmes et de visionner un impact ou une solution. Excellent communicateur et formateur, vous assurez une communication efficiente avec l’ensemble des parties prenantes et vous démarquez par votre force de persuasion et votre capacité à fédérer. Vous parlez parfaitement le français et l’anglais et maîtrisez les outils MS Office.

QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ?

Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités.

- Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité.

- Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité.

- Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons.

VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS

Si votre candidature est sélectionnée, l’équipe RH vous contacterons pour un premier échange téléphonique.

Ensuite, un entretien avec le manager direct sera planifié.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Retail Performance Insights Manager (F/M)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131020

Who are we?

A High Jewelry Maison with a strong heritage who promotes exceptional know-how in an enchanting and creative environment.

Our Maison is looking for talented individuals who contribute to developing and transmitting their expertise with care and no compromise. At Van Cleef & Arpels you will be surrounded by passionate experts and will contribute to many new projects which allows our Maison to regularly reinvent itself.

At Van Cleef & Arpels, we are proud to hire talents from many different backgrounds and experiences. We believe that diverse perspectives foster creativity and knowledge to deliver excellence.

ARE YOU A GOOD MATCH?

Your management and leadership skills allow you to collaborate, empower and communicate with different teams.

Analytical, you are pragmatic and results oriented

You are able to drive a portfolio of different projects with strong planning and organization skills

You have a strategic and business-oriented mindset.

You have a team player attitude and foster collaboration in the team.

You have knowledge of SQL, Python and Google Looker.

You are fluent in English.

WHAT ARE OUR EXPECTATIONS?

Within the International Retail Department and reporting to the Retail Performance Senior Manager, you will lead a team of analysts responsible for the creation, diffusion, maintenance, evolution and analysis of various performance indicators and reports for the Retail teams (HQ, regions, markets, boutiques) and the Maison Top Management.

In this function, you will:

• Act as a key ambassador, referent and expert for all retail performance analytical topics for HQ and regional stakeholders. You will identify emerging trends and opportunities.
• Lead the transition to new Looker reporting tools, encompassing data quality, oversee the design, development and maintenance of dashboards…
• Track key performance indicators and deliver actionable insights.
• Lead and manage a team of analysts.
• Drive a strong performance culture with training programs and build and nurture a cross-functional community.

MORE THAN A JOB...We recruit for a career!

By joining Van Cleef & Arpels you will be part of a Maison where employee career development is at the heart of our ambition.

Upon your arrival, you will be immersed into our enchanting world with trainings on our history, our know-how and our creations.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

Send your application online.

If your profile matches our search, you will be contacted by our HR team for an interview. Along the recruitment process you will meet the Retail Performance Senior Manager then the Retail Excellence Director. Otherwise, you will receive an email to inform you that your application has not been successful.

jobs.title: Associate Security Technology Engineer
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131014

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

The primary role of the Associate Security Technology Engineer is to support Richemont’s Group Operational Technology/Internet of Things (OT/IoT) security strategy through the deployment, operation, and continuous improvement of OT/IoT security technologies across manufacturing and industrial environments. It operates at the intersection of Group Security, Business Owners, and Maison manufacturing teams, ensuring that OT/IoT security capabilities are aligned with operational constraints, risk profiles, and Group security standards, reinforcing accountability within the First Line of Defense (Group Platform & Group Technology).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Deploy and implement OT/IOT security monitoring technologies across manufacturing and operational environments in line with Group Security standards.
• Act as an operational Group OT security interface for Manufacturing entities and selected Maisons and Group Platforms & Group Technology
• Execute the Group OT/IOT security strategy by translating defined requirements into operable and scalable security technology solutions.
• Ensure OT/IOT security monitoring technologies are operational, reliable, and delivering expected services within industrial availability and safety constraints.
• Operate and manage OT/IOT security technologies within assigned scope, ensuring compliance with Group policies and applicable industry regulations.
• Contribute to Group‑level security initiatives and projects on the OT/IOT technology track, working with cross‑functional stakeholders across regions and Maisons and Group functions
• Maintain and update documentation related to OT/IOT security technologies, including deployment, configuration, and operational procedures.
• Provide technical guidance and enablement to internal stakeholders and team members on the use of OT/IOT security technologies in manufacturing environments.
• Contribute & Supports OT SOC development.
• Supports CSIRT/FUSION Center, if required, in case of OT/IT incidents.
• Manage and/or contribute to projects, also outside of the OT/IOT scope, ran by Group Security Technology.
• Contribute to the general support within Group Security Technology.

REQUIREMENTS / SKILLS:

• Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Information Technology / Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in OT/IOT security/systems, evidenced by relevant industry certifications is an advantage.
• Hands-on experience in technical engineering and operational experience.
• Experience in cross-teams projects.
• Experience in a multinational, global environment.
• Proficiency in Windows and Unix/Linux OS environment.
• Knowledge of Python, or any other programming language is an asset.
• Knowledge of OT/IoT most common protocols and standards
• Knowledge of Cloud and Cloud Security.
• Exposure to industrial environments (manufacturing, production systems, etc.)
• Experience working with plant engineers, automation teams, or industrial vendors
• Excellent proficiency in English & French. Fluency in additional languages is a strong asset.
• Collaborative and open mindset, good listening skills, and strong feedback culture.
• Highly curious, proactive, autonomous, and agile.
• Outstanding personal and professional integrity and work ethics.
• Exceptional analytical mindset, keen attention to detail, and an advocate for cybersecurity.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

The primary role of the Associate Security Technology Engineer is to support Richemont’s Group Operational Technology/Internet of Things (OT/IoT) security strategy through the deployment, operation, and continuous improvement of OT/IoT security technologies across manufacturing and industrial environments. It operates at the intersection of Group Security, Business Owners, and Maison manufacturing teams, ensuring that OT/IoT security capabilities are aligned with operational constraints, risk profiles, and Group security standards, reinforcing accountability within the First Line of Defense (Group Platform & Group Technology).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Deploy and implement OT/IOT security monitoring technologies across manufacturing and operational environments in line with Group Security standards.
• Act as an operational Group OT security interface for Manufacturing entities and selected Maisons and Group Platforms & Group Technology
• Execute the Group OT/IOT security strategy by translating defined requirements into operable and scalable security technology solutions.
• Ensure OT/IOT security monitoring technologies are operational, reliable, and delivering expected services within industrial availability and safety constraints.
• Operate and manage OT/IOT security technologies within assigned scope, ensuring compliance with Group policies and applicable industry regulations.
• Contribute to Group‑level security initiatives and projects on the OT/IOT technology track, working with cross‑functional stakeholders across regions and Maisons and Group functions
• Maintain and update documentation related to OT/IOT security technologies, including deployment, configuration, and operational procedures.
• Provide technical guidance and enablement to internal stakeholders and team members on the use of OT/IOT security technologies in manufacturing environments.
• Contribute & Supports OT SOC development.
• Supports CSIRT/FUSION Center, if required, in case of OT/IT incidents.
• Manage and/or contribute to projects, also outside of the OT/IOT scope, ran by Group Security Technology.
• Contribute to the general support within Group Security Technology.

REQUIREMENTS / SKILLS:

• Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in Information Technology / Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in OT/IOT security/systems, evidenced by relevant industry certifications is an advantage.
• Hands-on experience in technical engineering and operational experience.
• Experience in cross-teams projects.
• Experience in a multinational, global environment.
• Proficiency in Windows and Unix/Linux OS environment.
• Knowledge of Python, or any other programming language is an asset.
• Knowledge of OT/IoT most common protocols and standards
• Knowledge of Cloud and Cloud Security.
• Exposure to industrial environments (manufacturing, production systems, etc.)
• Experience working with plant engineers, automation teams, or industrial vendors
• Excellent proficiency in English & French. Fluency in additional languages is a strong asset.
• Collaborative and open mindset, good listening skills, and strong feedback culture.
• Highly curious, proactive, autonomous, and agile.
• Outstanding personal and professional integrity and work ethics.
• Exceptional analytical mindset, keen attention to detail, and an advocate for cybersecurity.

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131266

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Be part of an exciting journey, assisting Richemont International SA (RISA) finance team, based in Villars sur Glâne. Supporting the financial planning and analysis department, you will contribute to streamline, automate and “data drive” our tools and processes.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

• Support FP&A team on cost controlling, forecasting and budgeting activities
• Contribute to monthly closing and reporting activities
• Provide support on ad hoc analysis, inquiries, and presentations
• Reengineer our dashboards and reports
• Help us leverage technology in our day-to-day routines
• Assist with process standardization, improvement and automation
• Encourage & stimulate shift to new technologies

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• You are in last year Master degree in finance, engineering or similar
• You are curious and have a self-driven mindset
• You are familiar with SAP or wish to further develop on the tool
• You are fluent in English and French

HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING?

This is a great opportunity to truly gain great insight into the luxury markets. You will be part of a dynamic and international work environment, where we always go the extra mile to uphold outstanding service for our clients.

• You will join a dynamic, diverse and challenging environment
• You will interact with several stakeholders across functions and countries
• Our offices will allow you to evolve in a modern and pleasant environment

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture
