jobs.title: Head of Group Insurance
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR130915

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

About us

Richemont is a global leader in the luxury sector, with a prestigious portfolio of Maisons spanning jewellery, watchmaking, and fashion. We are committed to excellence, innovation, and protecting our heritage, while anticipating future challenges.

How will you make an impact?

We are looking for an experienced and agile Head of Insurance to shape how Richemont manages risk in an increasingly dynamic global environment. As Head of Insurance, you will provide strategic leadership across our Group non-life insurance portfolio, acting as a true business partner to senior leaders to protect our people, assets, and balance sheets, while enabling sustainable growth.

This is a distinctive hands-on leadership role where you will define the strategic direction of the function and advise senior leadership, while remaining closely involved in execution. You will be perfectly comfortable presenting to the CFO in the morning and spending the afternoon reviewing wording on a complex policy, coaching a team member through a claim, or preparing a Board paper. You will lead from within the team, actively contributing and supporting, while also empowering your team members to grow with trust and confidence. Your agility will allow you to comfortably navigate and engage with diverse activities and people, from brokers to individual contributors across the Group.

Reporting to the Group Treasurer, you will be a trusted advisor to senior leadership and play a key role within the Treasury & Risk Leadership Team.

Your Key Responsibilities will be:

• Strategic Leadership: Shape and execute the Group’s non-life insurance and risk strategy, ensuring it evolves alongside our business priorities and risk profile. You will act as an internal entrepreneur, understanding insurance not just as a cost, but as a critical component of risk financing.
• Influential Business Partnership: Partner closely with senior leaders across the organization, acting as an ambassador for the insurance function. You will provide commercially pragmatic insurance advice that supports strategic initiatives, operational resilience, and informed decision-making, focusing on influence rather than mere negotiation. Building strong relationships with our Maisons will be paramount.
• Program Management & Innovation: Lead the design, placement, and governance of Group’s non-life insurance programs, including captive strategy, insurer and broker relationships, and effective claims oversight. You will foster innovation, curiosity, and embrace new approaches, including automation and AI, to continuously improve our processes.
• Function Optimization: Continuously enhance the effectiveness of the insurance function by leveraging data, technology, and process improvements to optimize the Group's total cost of risk.
• Strategic Advice Acumen: Provide strategic insight to the Group Treasurer and Treasury Leadership Team on emerging risks, market developments, and opportunities to strengthen the Group's financial resilience.
• Empowering Team Leadership: Foster a culture of partnership, accountability, and continuous improvement while leading, developing, and inspiring a high-performing global insurance team. You will ensure the team has the space to grow, supported by your trust and confidence.

What We Are Looking For:

We are looking for a leader whose approach goes beyond technical excellence. You are someone who:

• Builds trust and lasting relationships across a diverse, global organization, understanding that this role is fundamentally based on strong connections. You are a great business partner and ambassador for the function.
• Leads with integrity, authenticity, and a strong sense of accountability, setting an example for the team.
• Balances delegation with active, hands-on involvement, and demonstrate a genuine willingness to support the team in delivering results, while also empowering them to grow.
• Communicates with clarity and confidence, adapting complex insurance topics for a broad range of stakeholders, from senior executives to individual contributors, and knowing where to influence.
• Balances strategic thinking with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach, demonstrating agility in adapting to new challenges and environments.
• Is naturally curious, innovative, and collaborative, committed to developing both people and the function, and not afraid to explore new technologies.
• Possesses a good radar, understanding organizational dynamics and how to navigate them effectively.

Your Key Skills & Competencies:

• Mature, assertive, and self-motivated, demonstrating a positive and proactive attitude.
• A visionary leader, able to inspire and influence a highly specialized team towards excellence and value-added impact on the organization.
• Strategic thinking and business acumen with a strong foundation in finance, insurance, and risk management.
• Results-oriented, acts decisively, and an active team player.
• Strong customer focus (internal and external) with excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to present complex insurance information clearly to non-financial stakeholders, and confident in dealing with different management levels.
• Skilled at leading cross-functional projects from design to implementation.
• Advanced analytical, problem-solving, and data analysis skills.
• Digitally savvy and a strong interest in new technology use, automation.
• Unquestioned personal integrity with strong ethics and values consistent with company culture.
• Ability to stand firm on difficult issues when required.

Your qualifications:

• Degree in Business Administration, Finance, or Law.
• Minimum of 15 years of corporate insurance experience, preferably gained through a variety of in-house roles of increasing visibility and responsibility, combined with another experience like broker/consultancy.
• Expert knowledge of global insurance markets, international insurance programs, and captive experience. A captive board position is a plus.
• Deep experience in advising the internal organization on insurance matters
• Ability to think like a businessperson, to integrate insurance and business issues, and to partner with business leaders.
• Fluent English is a must.

What We Offer:

At Richemont, we value our employees and offer a stimulating and enriching work environment. You will have the opportunity to work within a prestigious international group, develop your skills, and contribute to the protection and growth of our iconic Maisons.

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

• We value and foster integrity, empathy, collaboration, excellence and courage.
• We care for the world we live in.

Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly.

If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview.

The next steps will be an interview with our Insurance specialists, our Group Treasurer, a behavioural assessment, and an interview with our HR Business Partner.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

• Balances strategic thinking with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach, demonstrating agility in adapting to new challenges and environments.
• Is naturally curious, innovative, and collaborative, committed to developing both people and the function, and not afraid to explore new technologies.
• Possesses a good radar, understanding organizational dynamics and how to navigate them effectively.

jobs.title: Technology Procurement Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131328

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

This is a unique opportunity to grow in an exciting and challenging environment, co-building and providing procurement expertise to technology-passionate stakeholders.

Richemont is looking for a Technology Procurement Intern to support our Technology Procurement team.

Reporting directly to the Head of Technology Procurement and the Technology Category Manager, you will support Group Technology teams in optimizing and executing sourcing strategies for cutting-edge IT categories—including SaaS, cloud services, software, professional services, and hardware—delivering optimal value in terms of quality, service, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

• Location: Meyrin (Geneva area)
• Contract Type: 5-month fixed-term contract (Internship)
• Start Date: ideally January 2027

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

In close partnership with our Group Technology department, Maisons, and regions, you will ensure the successful implementation of our procurement policies and global sourcing strategies.

Contribute to Global Category Management:

• Market Intelligence: Support category intelligence management, including category analysis, spend and risk analysis and best practices identification, to facilitate the implementation of category strategies across the organisation
• Supplier Relations: Support the management of the preferred suppliers list
• Value Creation: Propose value creation initiatives, such as rationalization opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
• Performance: Contribute to enhancing category performance reporting.

Support stakeholders in their sourcing and supplier management activities:

• Advisory: Collaborate closely with stakeholders and advise them on optimal sourcing strategies
• Process Execution: Actively contribute to defining technical/business requirements and performing procurement actions in accordance with Group policies.
• Full Sourcing Support: Provide comprehensive procurement support for technology-related needs:
• Negotiate the best conditions TCO-wise (pricing, terms and conditions, SLA, etc.)
• Provide procurement support throughout technology projects, including managing RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs, as well as contract renewals.
• Ensure compliance with the negotiated terms.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• You are a proactive team player who communicates clearly and brings positive energy to collaborative goals.
• You are naturally curious, highly structured, and possess strong analytical skills.
• You are fluent in both English and French (written and spoken).
• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (for data and spend analysis) and PowerPoint (for clear presentations).
• You are in your 4th or, ideally, 5th year of a Master’s degree majoring in Procurement, Supply Chain, or a related business field.
• You have an active internship agreement (convention de stage) with your school or university.
• You are available for a 5-month internship ideally starting in September 2026.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?
This is a premium opportunity to discover and contribute to both projects and category management within a leading global luxury group. You will join a diverse, dynamic, and highly supportive team working in an international environment where innovation and heritage meet.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

• First Contact: If your application is selected, our recruitment team will reach out to you within one week for a brief, informal introductory call.
• First Interview: A formal interview with our Recruiter to discuss your background and motivations.
• Final Round: A personal meeting (virtual or in-person) with the Technology Procurement Team to dive deeper into the role and meet your future colleagues.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Spécialiste Métier Usinage (Polissage mécanisé)
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131376

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

En tant que Spécialiste Métier, vous serez un pilier essentiel de notre atelier de production. Vos responsabilités s'articuleront autour de deux axes majeurs :

• Apporter une expertise technique pointue sur les procédés de préparation/terminaison sur nos machines CT500/CT501 (en assurant la robustesse des procédés, la reproductibilité des résultats et l’optimisation des performances industrielles) et un soutien opérationnel direct à nos équipes de production.
• Participer activement à l'organisation du travail pour garantir l'optimisation de la qualité, des quantités produites, et l'efficacité des flux au sein de l'atelier.

Vous êtes l’interlocuteur privilégié pour toutes les problématiques liées aux équipements CT500/501, aux outillages, aux consommables, …

Vous assurez le lien technique entre les ateliers d’usinage et de polissage afin de garantir la conformité des états de surface et le respect des exigences esthétiques.

Vos responsabilités au quotidien :

Expertise Technique et Formation

• Participer activement à la production et garantir les bonnes pratiques techniques
• Apporter un soutien technique quotidien aux collaborateurs et veiller à l'application des instructions de poste, notamment pour le réglage, la maintenance de premier niveau et le dépannage des machines.
• Identifier les besoins en formation technique, former les équipes et proposer des améliorations continues aux processus.
• Réaliser des analyses de défauts/problématiques et proposer un plan d’actions associé.

Optimisation de l'Organisation et de la Performance

• Contribuer à l'ordonnancement et à l'organisation du travail (distribution, planning), en collaboration avec le responsable d’atelier.
• Assurer le suivi rigoureux des plannings, des délais et des quantités produites
• Participer à la répartition des collaborateurs et de la charge de travail sur les équipements, ainsi qu'au suivi des indicateurs de performance (rendements, rebuts, rhabillages)

Garantie de la Qualité

• Résoudre les problèmes techniques et les non-conformités qualité directement sur le terrain
• Participer activement aux démarches d'amélioration continue (5R/5S) et réaliser des audits qualité des processus
• Contribuer à l'amélioration des flux en lien avec les autres départements

Soutien au Management

• Relayer les informations techniques clés concernant les équipements et favoriser un climat de travail positif et motivant au sein de l'équipe
• Contribuer à l'évaluation de la polyvalence technique des équipes et encadrer les candidats en essai sur ces équipements
• Être force de proposition sur les aspects techniques, organisationnels et d'amélioration de la performance

Votre profil :

• Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation technique pertinente en mécanique, micromécanique, usinage ou production, ou justifiez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement de production similaire, avec des machines de polissage mécanisé.
• Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie et une expérience pratique avérée des machines de polissage Recomatic CT500/CT501 ou d'équipements comparables.
• Vous maîtrisez les principes et les techniques d'usinage et de finition de précision.
• Vous faites preuve d'un excellent sens de l'organisation et savez gérer les priorités avec efficacité dans un environnement de production exigeant.
• Vos compétences en communication sont avérées, vous permettant d'interagir avec aisance à tous les niveaux, notamment pour la formation et le support technique spécialisé.
• Vous possédez une très bonne gestion du stress et savez maintenir une attitude positive et motivante.
• Vous avez un bon esprit d'initiative et êtes force de proposition pour l'amélioration continue des processus.
• Vous maîtrisez les connaissances informatiques de base, incluant potentiellement des logiciels de programmation machine ou de suivi de production.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Strategic Projects Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131449

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

YOUR MISSION:

As a valued member of the Strategic Projects team, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to critical initiatives across the Richemont Group. You will actively engage with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders, utilizing your communication and theoretical skills to facilitate collaboration, align objectives, and support partners throughout project lifecycles. This position offers an unparalleled opportunity to develop and apply your project management expertise, encompassing comprehensive reporting, proactive risk management, and meticulous planning, all while learning from experienced professionals. You will be an integral part of a visionary journey, contributing to the strategic evolution of a luxury leader and gaining invaluable experience in navigating complex challenges within a dynamic global environment.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

You will gain practical experience and make a real difference by focusing on these key responsibilities:

•

Coordination & Project Planning: Take an active role in planning, executing, and monitoring strategic projects across the Group. This includes assisting in defining project scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines. You will gain hands-on experience to ensure efficient project delivery and contribute to the expansion of Richemont's strategic capabilities.

Stakeholder Communication & Management: Serve as a key point of contact for project-related communications. You will be responsible for interacting with stakeholders from various departments within the Group, providing regular updates on project status, managing expectations, and facilitating effective collaboration to ensure alignment and foster a shared understanding of project goals.

Performance & Financial Reporting: Contribute to the development and delivery of comprehensive project reports, including financial tracking, performance metrics, and progress tracking. Your analytical skills will be crucial in identifying key trends, assessing project health, and providing data-driven insights to support informed decision-making by project leadership.

Risk Management & Problem Solving: Assist in identifying potential project risks, developing mitigation strategies, and tracking their resolution. You will apply your problem-solving skills to address challenges that arise during project execution, ensuring minimal disruption and maintaining project momentum.

Partner Guidance & Facilitation: Guide external partners involved in projects, ensuring they understand their roles, responsibilities, and project methodologies. You will facilitate workshops and meetings, promoting effective teamwork and ensuring successful execution of project initiatives.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

You are a Bachelor’s or Master’s student (Business or Engineering School) with a strong desire to enter the field of Project Management.

You are open-minded, with effective communication skills (in English and ideally in French as well).

You have strong analytical skills, being able to think logically and pay attention to detail. You can easily navigate from a conceptual level of information to a deeper one.

You have a strong team spirit, you are proactive, enthusiastic, and not afraid of new challenges.

You are comfortable working in a group or independently in a hybrid manner with a focus on efficiency and human interactions.

You master Microsoft Office tools like Excel, PowerPoint...

You are effective in coordinating projects and have good problem-solving skills.

Ideally, you also have a financial skills background.

You are available for a 6-month internship as of September 2026.

An internship agreement with your school/university is mandatory.

You will be offered an opportunity to actively contribute to the establishment of a strategic function within the CIO Office for the Richemont Group and its Maisons. To be part of a dynamic and diverse environment within high-value teams, who possess diverse skills, collaborate effectively, communicate openly, respect one another, and are driven by a shared commitment to achieving goals. The Richemont Group offers you numerous opportunities to ensure healthy and progressive career development in the future.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

YOUR MISSION:

As a valued member of the Strategic Projects team, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to critical initiatives across the Richemont Group. You will actively engage with a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders, utilizing your communication and theoretical skills to facilitate collaboration, align objectives, and support partners throughout project lifecycles. This position offers an unparalleled opportunity to develop and apply your project management expertise, encompassing comprehensive reporting, proactive risk management, and meticulous planning, all while learning from experienced professionals. You will be an integral part of a visionary journey, contributing to the strategic evolution of a luxury leader and gaining invaluable experience in navigating complex challenges within a dynamic global environment.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

You will gain practical experience and make a real difference by focusing on these key responsibilities:

•

Coordination & Project Planning: Take an active role in planning, executing, and monitoring strategic projects across the Group. This includes assisting in defining project scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines. You will gain hands-on experience to ensure efficient project delivery and contribute to the expansion of Richemont's strategic capabilities.

Stakeholder Communication & Management: Serve as a key point of contact for project-related communications. You will be responsible for interacting with stakeholders from various departments within the Group, providing regular updates on project status, managing expectations, and facilitating effective collaboration to ensure alignment and foster a shared understanding of project goals.

Performance & Financial Reporting: Contribute to the development and delivery of comprehensive project reports, including financial tracking, performance metrics, and progress tracking. Your analytical skills will be crucial in identifying key trends, assessing project health, and providing data-driven insights to support informed decision-making by project leadership.

Risk Management & Problem Solving: Assist in identifying potential project risks, developing mitigation strategies, and tracking their resolution. You will apply your problem-solving skills to address challenges that arise during project execution, ensuring minimal disruption and maintaining project momentum.

Partner Guidance & Facilitation: Guide external partners involved in projects, ensuring they understand their roles, responsibilities, and project methodologies. You will facilitate workshops and meetings, promoting effective teamwork and ensuring successful execution of project initiatives.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

You are a Bachelor’s or Master’s student (Business or Engineering School) with a strong desire to enter the field of Project Management.

You are open-minded, with effective communication skills (in English and ideally in French as well).

You have strong analytical skills, being able to think logically and pay attention to detail. You can easily navigate from a conceptual level of information to a deeper one.

You have a strong team spirit, you are proactive, enthusiastic, and not afraid of new challenges.

You are comfortable working in a group or independently in a hybrid manner with a focus on efficiency and human interactions.

You master Microsoft Office tools like Excel, PowerPoint...

You are effective in coordinating projects and have good problem-solving skills.

Ideally, you also have a financial skills background.

You are available for a 6-month internship as of September 2026.

An internship agreement with your school/university is mandatory.

You will be offered an opportunity to actively contribute to the establishment of a strategic function within the CIO Office for the Richemont Group and its Maisons. To be part of a dynamic and diverse environment within high-value teams, who possess diverse skills, collaborate effectively, communicate openly, respect one another, and are driven by a shared commitment to achieving goals. The Richemont Group offers you numerous opportunities to ensure healthy and progressive career development in the future.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131471

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Richemont is looking for a Senior Manager Data and Analytics to lead a team of data professionals within the Group Responsible and Strategic Procurement department.

Reporting to the Procurement Excellence Director, the Senior Manager Data and Analytics will be responsible for defining, implementing, and overseeing the Group Responsible and Strategic Procurement data strategy, analytics capabilities and data governance framework, enabling the Experts within Group Responsible and Strategic Procurement department as well as other stakeholders across the Group such as the Regions and the Maisons, Group Sustainability function, etc.

This role drives the transformation of raw data into actionable insights that are key to better understanding or our supply chains, informed business decisions, optimized operations, enhanced customer experiences, and identifying new growth opportunities, fostering a data-driven culture, and ensuring ethical and compliant use of data.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Leadership & Vision:

•

Develop and articulate comprehensive data and analytics vision and strategy aligned with the overall business objectives, fast evolving sustainability regulations context and digital transformation initiatives.

Identify, design and prioritize key business questions that can be answered through data analysis, driving value creation.

Champion a data-driven culture across the organization, promoting data literacy and the use of analytics for decision-making.

Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data science, machine learning, and business intelligence.

Act as a strategic advisor to Responsible and Strategic Procurement Leadership, utilizing data-driven insights to identify cost-savings opportunities, mitigate supply chain risks, and drive value creation.

Data Management & Governance:

Establish and enforce robust data governance policies, standards, and procedures to ensure data quality, integrity, security, privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, Non Financial Report,...).

Oversee the architecture, design, and implementation of data platforms and in-house applications, data warehouses, and other data infrastructure.

Manage data acquisition, integration, storage, and accessibility across various systems and sources.

Ensure data lineage, metadata management, and master data management (MDM) practices are in place.

Analytics & Insights Generation:

Pioneer and lead the development and deployment of advanced analytics, predictive modelling, and machine learning solutions to solve complex business problems.

Oversee the creation of dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders at all levels.

Design and deliver Maisons’ facing reporting frameworks, adapting outputs to varied maturity levels across 20+ Maisons and Regions

Collaborate with the department Experts to understand their analytical needs and deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable impact

Propose innovative solutions to enhance effectiveness and efficiency of analytics processes.

Apply data science methodologies to analyse spend and buying patterns, drive cost savings, mitigate supply and continuity risks, and ensure contract and policy compliance.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:

Partner closely with Group Data Office teams to operationalise Analytics and AI solutions end-to-end, ensuring they are production-ready, scalable and fully integrated into user experience.

Act as a primary liaison between the data and analytics team, Category Managers, Responsible Sourcing leads, Maisons and Regions and department Experts/internal stakeholders

Effectively communicate complex analytical findings and recommendations clearly and concisely to non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

Develop compelling visualisations and data-driven narratives to communicate insights effectively to operational and executive audiences.

Build strong relationships with internal and external partners to leverage data capabilities.

Team Management & Development:

Manage and develop a team of data professionals, fostering a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team environment.

Provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the team.

Actively upskill the team in advanced analytical methodologies, data storytelling, and the application of next generation AI tools in Procurement.

Communicate project status, risks and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

8+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related field, including experience in a management role.

Business Acumen:

Understanding of business processes and the ability to connect data insights to business objectives.

Proven track record of developing and executing data strategies that deliver significant business value.

Curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding business challenges.

Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into clear technical specifications with strong stakeholder management, communication and presentations skills.

Proven ability to translate regulatory compliance requirements into data architecture and collection frameworks

Technical Skills:

Deep understanding of the digital Procurement ecosystem (SAP Ariba,...).

Experience with large-scale data platforms and technologies (e.g., cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, GCP; ...).

Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and data privacy principles.

Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data science (e.g. SQL, Python, R).

Strong, practical understanding of Generative AI (Gen AI) and Agentic AI frameworks, and how they can be applied to optimize procurement processes.

Expertise in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI, Tableau).

Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform).

Spreadsheet Software: advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, advanced formulas, data modelling).

Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and statistical modelling techniques and their application in business.

Knowledge of database management systems and ETL processes.

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:

Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.

Exceptional critical thinking abilities to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions.

Ability to identify root causes of problems and propose data-driven solutions.

Interpersonal Skills:

A strategic mindset with a highly collaborative and consultative approach to problem-solving

Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.

Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value, collegiality, Courage, Curiosity, Empathy, Humility and Integrity.
- We care for the world we live in.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Act as a strategic advisor to Responsible and Strategic Procurement Leadership, utilizing data-driven insights to identify cost-savings opportunities, mitigate supply chain risks, and drive value creation.

Establish and enforce robust data governance policies, standards, and procedures to ensure data quality, integrity, security, privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR, Non Financial Report,...).

Oversee the architecture, design, and implementation of data platforms and in-house applications, data warehouses, and other data infrastructure.

Manage data acquisition, integration, storage, and accessibility across various systems and sources.

Ensure data lineage, metadata management, and master data management (MDM) practices are in place.

Analytics & Insights Generation:

Pioneer and lead the development and deployment of advanced analytics, predictive modelling, and machine learning solutions to solve complex business problems.

Oversee the creation of dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that provide clear, actionable insights to stakeholders at all levels.

Design and deliver Maisons’ facing reporting frameworks, adapting outputs to varied maturity levels across 20+ Maisons and Regions

Collaborate with the department Experts to understand their analytical needs and deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable impact

Propose innovative solutions to enhance effectiveness and efficiency of analytics processes.

Apply data science methodologies to analyse spend and buying patterns, drive cost savings, mitigate supply and continuity risks, and ensure contract and policy compliance.

Partner closely with Group Data Office teams to operationalise Analytics and AI solutions end-to-end, ensuring they are production-ready, scalable and fully integrated into user experience.

Act as a primary liaison between the data and analytics team, Category Managers, Responsible Sourcing leads, Maisons and Regions and department Experts/internal stakeholders

Effectively communicate complex analytical findings and recommendations clearly and concisely to non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

Develop compelling visualisations and data-driven narratives to communicate insights effectively to operational and executive audiences.

Build strong relationships with internal and external partners to leverage data capabilities.

Manage and develop a team of data professionals, fostering a collaborative, innovative, and high-performance team environment.

Provide technical guidance and thought leadership to the team.

Actively upskill the team in advanced analytical methodologies, data storytelling, and the application of next generation AI tools in Procurement.

Communicate project status, risks and outcomes to leadership and stakeholders

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

8+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, or a related field, including experience in a management role.

Business Acumen:

Understanding of business processes and the ability to connect data insights to business objectives.

Proven track record of developing and executing data strategies that deliver significant business value.

Curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding business challenges.

Demonstrated ability to translate complex business requirements into clear technical specifications with strong stakeholder management, communication and presentations skills.

Proven ability to translate regulatory compliance requirements into data architecture and collection frameworks

Deep understanding of the digital Procurement ecosystem (SAP Ariba,...).

Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and data privacy principles.

Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data science (e.g. SQL, Python, R).

Strong, practical understanding of Generative AI (Gen AI) and Agentic AI frameworks, and how they can be applied to optimize procurement processes.

Expertise in data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Power BI, Tableau).

Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform).

Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and statistical modelling techniques and their application in business.

Knowledge of database management systems and ETL processes.

Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:

Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.

Exceptional critical thinking abilities to interpret data and draw meaningful conclusions.

Ability to identify root causes of problems and propose data-driven solutions.

Interpersonal Skills:

A strategic mindset with a highly collaborative and consultative approach to problem-solving

Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely.

Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

jobs.title: Référent Chef de Projet Industrialisation
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131555

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS AVOIR UN IMPACT ?

Vous êtes un pilier de l'industrialisation, capable de piloter des projets complexes et de structurer les méthodes ? Rejoignez notre équipe et ayez un impact direct sur nos deux sites de production, en horlogerie comme en joaillerie !

Sous la responsabilité du Responsable des Méthodes, vous serez le point d'entrée stratégique pour l'industrialisation et la conduite de projet.

Vos missions principales :

•

Pilotage et Centralisation (50%) : Vous assurez le suivi rigoureux de l'avancement des projets d'industrialisation, garantissant le respect des standards (industrialisation, PLM/ERP) et des plannings. Vous collaborez étroitement avec le Responsable des Méthodes pour optimiser la performance, réduire les coûts, gérer les priorités et définir les standards. Vous centralisez également les sujets techniques liés à la conception en production (CAO/PLM, impression 3D).

Industrialisation de Nouveautés (50%) : En tant que Chef de Projet Industrialisation, vous prenez en charge la mise en production de nouveaux produits ou les modifications de l'existant. Vous définissez les gammes de fabrication, les coûts, les matières premières et les outillages. Vous suivez les préséries, élaborez les procédés et réalisez les dossiers d'industrialisation.

Support et Expertise : Vous êtes le référent technique des ateliers, apportant votre soutien et travaillant en partenariat avec les équipes de production. Vous assurez également la mise à jour et la maintenance des bases de données techniques.

COMMENT ALLEZ-VOUS RÉUSSIR AVEC NOUS ?

Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur et/ou de technicien ET (ou d’un titre équivalent), vous êtes au bénéfice d’une expérience d’au moins 5 années dans un poste similaire.

Doté de très bonnes connaissances sur un logiciel de CAO, idéalement CREO, vous avez idéalement eu l’occasion de découvrir le monde de l’habillage horloger ou de la joaillerie à travers votre parcours professionnel ainsi que la gestion de projet.

QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ?

Nous offrons des horaires flexibles dans un cadre de travail varié et stimulant. Nous bénéficions des avantages de la convention collective de travail des industries horlogères et microtechnique suisse dont 5 semaines de vacances par années auxquelles s’ajoutent des congés additionnels liés au rattrapage.

Soucieux de notre impact environnemental, nous privilégions la mobilité douce ainsi que les transports en commun avec une participation financière. Notre restaurant propose chaque jour des repas frais et variés à prix avantageux. Orienté vers le bien-être au travail, notre comité évènement propose de nombreuses activités culturelles et sportives tout au long de l'année.

De plus, le groupe Richemont a été certifié Equal-Pay, ce qui assure une rémunération équitable pour l'ensemble de nos collaborateurs. Sans oublier notre caisse de pension Richemont qui offre de bonnes prestations permettant à chaque collaborateur d’assurer au mieux leur avenir financier lié aux prestations sociales.

QU'EST-CE QUI DISTINGUE NOTRE GROUPE ?

Notre véritable force ne réside pas dans nos similitudes, mais dans la riche diversité de nos arts, de nos cultures et de nos compétences humaines, ainsi que dans notre capacité spécifique à encourager les potentiels inexploités.

Nous valorisons la liberté, la collégialité, la loyauté et la solidarité

Nous encourageons l'empathie, la curiosité, le courage, l'humilité et l'intégrité

Nous prenons soin du monde dans lequel nous vivons

VOTRE VOYAGE AVEC NOUS

Si votre profil correspond à notre recherche, vous serez, dans un premier temps, contacté par les Ressources humaines pour un appel exploratoire.

Par la suite, un premier entretien avec le Responsable Méthodes ainsi que les Ressources humaines vous sera proposé, puis un second avec d’autres intervenants hiérarchiques.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Vos missions principales :

•

Pilotage et Centralisation (50%) : Vous assurez le suivi rigoureux de l'avancement des projets d'industrialisation, garantissant le respect des standards (industrialisation, PLM/ERP) et des plannings. Vous collaborez étroitement avec le Responsable des Méthodes pour optimiser la performance, réduire les coûts, gérer les priorités et définir les standards. Vous centralisez également les sujets techniques liés à la conception en production (CAO/PLM, impression 3D).

Industrialisation de Nouveautés (50%) : En tant que Chef de Projet Industrialisation, vous prenez en charge la mise en production de nouveaux produits ou les modifications de l'existant. Vous définissez les gammes de fabrication, les coûts, les matières premières et les outillages. Vous suivez les préséries, élaborez les procédés et réalisez les dossiers d'industrialisation.

Support et Expertise : Vous êtes le référent technique des ateliers, apportant votre soutien et travaillant en partenariat avec les équipes de production. Vous assurez également la mise à jour et la maintenance des bases de données techniques.

QU’AVONS-NOUS A VOUS OFFRIR ?

Soucieux de notre impact environnemental, nous privilégions la mobilité douce ainsi que les transports en commun avec une participation financière. jobs.title: Horloger HH
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131708

Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai forged its reputation by developing precision instruments and professional watches for the Royal Italian Navy, renowned for their reliability and functional design. Rooted in performance, purpose, and precision, the Maison embraces its heritage while pushing the boundaries of innovation, combining Italian design with Swiss expertise. Today, Panerai continues to create tool watches that serve as trusted companions for every adventure, even in the most demanding environments.

En tant que futur(e) Horloger(ère) Haute Horlogerie, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'assemblage et la mise au point de nos montres. Grâce à votre expertise et à votre exigence de qualité, vous contribuerez à garantir la précision, la fiabilité et la performance qui font la réputation de notre Maison.

Votre impact

jobs.title: Concepteur Constructeur Mouvement
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131752

Since 1833, driven by an unquenchable thirst for innovation and creativity, and inspired by the peaceful natural surroundings of its home in the Vallée de Joux, Jaeger-LeCoultre has been distinguished by its mastery of complications and the precision of its mechanisms. Known as the Watchmaker of Watchmakers, the Manufacture has expressed its relentlessly inventive spirit through the creation of more than 1,400 different calibres and the award of more than 430 patents. Harnessing 190 years of accumulated expertise, La Grande Maison’s watchmakers design, produce, finish and ornament the most advanced and precise mechanisms, blending passion with centuries-old savoir-faire, linking the past to the future, timeless but always up with the times. With 180 skills brought together under one roof, the Manufacture creates fine timepieces that combine technical ingenuity with aesthetic beauty and a distinctively understated sophistication.

Pour notre Manufacture située au Sentier (Vallée de Joux - Canton de Vaud), et au sein de notre département développement
mouvement, vous êtes en charge de concevoir et développer les mouvements core range et haute horlogerie en collaboration avec le
Chef de projet, le Design, le Marketing et les Méthodes.

COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ? VOS RESPONSABILITÉS :
• Réaliser la pré-étude, la conception et la construction sur le logiciel CAO-3D ainsi que la gestion des attributs liés au PLM.
• Assurer le cycle de vie de nos produits et la mise à disposition des données techniques via notre PLM.
• Suivre la réalisation du dossier de plan et assurer la conformité.
• Animer les revues de conception.
• Accompagner le développement jusqu’à l’homologation du produit.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le laboratoire horloger et les méthodes.
• Assurer le support technique et la mise à jour des dossiers techniques

LA CLEF DE VOTRE SUCCÈS ? VOS COMPÉTENCES !
Au bénéfice d’une formation supérieure en construction horlogère ou en microtechnique avec option en construction horlogère, vous
possédez une expérience confirmée de 5 ans minimum dans le domaine de la construction mouvement horloger, ainsi que de solides
notions des matériaux, des calculs des structures en simulations numériques ainsi que la maitrise des normes NIHS, GPS … . Passionné
par la Haute Horlogerie et les complications, vous êtes rigoureux, méthodique et créatif. Vous appréciez travailler en équipe, tout en
étant autonome au quotidien. La maîtrise d’un premier logiciel de PLM ainsi que la maîtrise du logiciel PTC Creo sont des atouts.

jobs.title: Data Project Management Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131779

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Company Overview:

Our company is a major luxury group consisting of renowned luxury Maisons. As a leader in the luxury industry, we strive to maintain our prestigious reputation and continue driving innovation. The Group Data Office plays a pivotal role in developing the data strategy for the entire group and empowering each Maison to harness the power of data to create value and drive growth.

Position Overview:

As a key player in Richemont’s data transformation journey led by the Group Data Office, the Data Project Manager Intern will support the enablement of our Maisons, Functions, Divisions and Regions in their capacity to manage and leverage their data securely, autonomously and at scale.

Within the Data Enablement team and reporting to our Senior Data Program Manager, the ideal candidate will support in the organization and orchestration of the transformation program for our business entities, focusing on change management, communication, and training coordination.

Responsibilities:

Assist in Data Transformation Program Management:

• Help manage the portfolio of initiatives on the data transformation roadmap.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including Group Technology, Analytics Enablement and Governance Enablement teams to create transformation roadmap, map interdependencies and track progress
• Collaborate with Maisons and Group Functions to define Data Transformation program objectives and scope.

jobs.title: Master Data Administrator – Finance
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131611

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

As Master Data Administrator, you will be responsible for the operational stewardship and daily maintenance of financially relevant master data, ensuring its consistency, completeness and timely updates across multiple systems.

You will execute master data processes in line with business priorities, internal guidelines and master data best practices, supporting the efficient execution of finance and business processes. Playing a crucial role in the day-to-day management of critical foundational master data, you will ensure alignment with defined rules and controls, perform verification activities, support users and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and business projects.

How will you make an impact?

As part of Group Finance and based in Bellevue, your responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to, the following key areas:

Master Data Stewardship and Controls

• Maintain financial master data (e.g. boutiques, investment projects, profit centers, chart of accounts and key translation tables) in SAP SEM and SAP ERP
• Coordinate processes and maintain legal entity master data for consistency across financial, corporate, contract, and treasury systems.
• Manage the Group article hierarchy in ERP, aligning Brand requirements with Group Finance guidelines.
• Maintain hierarchy, coordinate changes, and validate financially relevant article master data.
• For all master data domains, execute controls for integrity, security, and compliance, as well as operate/maintain processes and tools, and create documentation.

Master Data Quality Management

• Conduct regular data audits and reconciliation to ensure master data consistency, accuracy, and compliance across systems.
• Support implementation and maintenance of data quality processes and tools with stakeholders.
• Apply and support data governance policies for master data objects, focusing on cross-system data quality standards.

Continuous Improvement and Business Support

• Identify and support implementation of master data process and tool enhancements.
• Provide operational input for master data system enhancements and new functionalities.
• Act as an operational reference in business projects for master data, contributing to system implementations and improvements.
• Serve as a point of contact for master data queries, guiding users and troubleshooting issues.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Transversal skills

• Ability to work across different levels of the organization and various functional teams, facilitating communication between end users and regional counterparts.
• Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy when working with complex data sets.
• Practical problem-solving for operational data issues and user support
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to support users, clarify requests and coordinate operational master data activities.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.

Education, experience and core competencies

• Master of Science in Finance or similar field with data science and economics background
• 3 years’ experience in finance data analysis, with exposure to multiple systems, within a multinational Luxury company
• Strong expertise in financial modelling, using BI tools (PBI, SAC, Looker, etc.)
• Proficiency in SAP FI/CO modules
• Expert in Excel
• Proficient in basic data checks, reporting extracts and operational follow-up tools, including PBI, Google Looker or similar.
• Familiar with data governance policies and procedures, with the ability to apply defined rules in daily activities.
• Familiar with Robotic Process Automation (RPA), AI prompting and basic automation concepts.
• Proficiency in French and English is required

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value, collegiality, Courage, Curiosity, Empathy, Humility and Integrity.
- We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

As Master Data Administrator, you will be responsible for the operational stewardship and daily maintenance of financially relevant master data, ensuring its consistency, completeness and timely updates across multiple systems.

You will execute master data processes in line with business priorities, internal guidelines and master data best practices, supporting the efficient execution of finance and business processes. Playing a crucial role in the day-to-day management of critical foundational master data, you will ensure alignment with defined rules and controls, perform verification activities, support users and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and business projects.

How will you make an impact?

As part of Group Finance and based in Bellevue, your responsibilities will encompass, but are not limited to, the following key areas:

Master Data Stewardship and Controls

• Maintain financial master data (e.g. boutiques, investment projects, profit centers, chart of accounts and key translation tables) in SAP SEM and SAP ERP
• Coordinate processes and maintain legal entity master data for consistency across financial, corporate, contract, and treasury systems.
• Manage the Group article hierarchy in ERP, aligning Brand requirements with Group Finance guidelines.
• Maintain hierarchy, coordinate changes, and validate financially relevant article master data.
• For all master data domains, execute controls for integrity, security, and compliance, as well as operate/maintain processes and tools, and create documentation.

Master Data Quality Management

• Conduct regular data audits and reconciliation to ensure master data consistency, accuracy, and compliance across systems.
• Support implementation and maintenance of data quality processes and tools with stakeholders.
• Apply and support data governance policies for master data objects, focusing on cross-system data quality standards.

Continuous Improvement and Business Support

• Identify and support implementation of master data process and tool enhancements.
• Provide operational input for master data system enhancements and new functionalities.
• Act as an operational reference in business projects for master data, contributing to system implementations and improvements.
• Serve as a point of contact for master data queries, guiding users and troubleshooting issues.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Transversal skills

• Ability to work across different levels of the organization and various functional teams, facilitating communication between end users and regional counterparts.
• Meticulous attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy when working with complex data sets.
• Practical problem-solving for operational data issues and user support
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to support users, clarify requests and coordinate operational master data activities.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.

Education, experience and core competencies

• Master of Science in Finance or similar field with data science and economics background
• 3 years’ experience in finance data analysis, with exposure to multiple systems, within a multinational Luxury company
• Strong expertise in financial modelling, using BI tools (PBI, SAC, Looker, etc.)
• Proficiency in SAP FI/CO modules
• Expert in Excel
• Proficient in basic data checks, reporting extracts and operational follow-up tools, including PBI, Google Looker or similar.
• Familiar with data governance policies and procedures, with the ability to apply defined rules in daily activities.
• Familiar with Robotic Process Automation (RPA), AI prompting and basic automation concepts.
• Proficiency in French and English is required

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value, collegiality, Courage, Curiosity, Empathy, Humility and Integrity.
- We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

Your application will be carefully reviewed by our recruitment teams, who will give you a follow-up shortly. If your profile is selected, we will contact you for an initial phone interview. The next step will be an interview with the Managers and our HR Business Partner.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Group Talent Acquisition Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR131860

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

As our Group Talent Acquisition Intern, you will support our Group TA Project Manager in ensuring our TA community have a good understanding of our tools, systems and methodologies, to reach hiring success. In this role, you will assist our efforts in optimizing our recruiting activities, to ensure our Regions and Maisons can meet the unique and exciting growth that lies ahead. This role reports to the Group Talent Acquisition Director, and collaborates with our Group Talent team.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT ?

- You will coordinate initiatives and projects that ensure we co-drive the TA transformation into the future together.
- You will be part of our global TA community, collecting any TA-related needs, ensuring we keep supporting our collaborative way of working
- You will coordinate and support on TA trainings and guidelines’ creation for the TA community that will lead to best-in-class hiring experience
- You will be supporting analytics and reporting initiatives linked to our data accuracy efforts, spreading from diversity hiring, University engagement and will assist in data analysis to track our successes
- You will collaborate with Employer Branding and University team on various projects, ensuring we create appropriate materials and update our toolkits for all our HR population

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?
We welcome people from diverse backgrounds who desire to build upon years of tradition, craftmanship and innovation. If you have a people focused approach, perseverance and a curious mindset, then do not hesitate to apply!

- You are currently enrolled in a Master’s Degree in Human Resources, Communications, Data Analytics, Business Administration or similar
- You are at ease with technology, and enjoy working with data
- You have a business mindset, always thinking of opportunities to improve the status quo
- Excellent written and oral English language skills, another language is a plus
- Ability to plan, co-ordinate and react quickly to changes, to prioritize and manage your own workload
- High attention to detail
- Internship agreement with your school/university mandatory
- You are available to start a 6-months internship in September 2026 or later

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?
Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value collegiality, empathy, curiosity, courage, humility and integrity.
- We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US:
If your application is selected we will reach out shortly for an introductory interview. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Boutique Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132136

Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai forged its reputation by developing precision instruments and professional watches for the Royal Italian Navy, renowned for their reliability and functional design. Rooted in performance, purpose, and precision, the Maison embraces its heritage while pushing the boundaries of innovation, combining Italian design with Swiss expertise. Today, Panerai continues to create tool watches that serve as trusted companions for every adventure, even in the most demanding environments.

As our next Boutique Manager, you will embark on a pivotal mission to shape the success of our prestigious Geneva boutique. You will develop and optimize the boutique performance and profitability through operational excellence and a refined clienteling strategy, maximizing sales and ensuring every interaction reflects our Maison's standards. As a true ambassador, you will lead, coach, and inspire your team in line with our Maison’s values, fostering talent development for individual career growth and collective team success.

Your impact

•

Drive and exceed global commercial, qualitative, and operational performance objectives through strategic planning, rigorous analysis, and adherence to Maison and Group standards.

Develop and execute market strategies, including in-boutique events and external networking, to enhance commercial opportunities and adapt to local economic environments.

Cultivate strong client loyalty and relationships, particularly with VVIPs, by leveraging CRM tools and fostering a data-driven culture for optimal customer insights.

Ensure impeccable retail execution and operational discipline, utilizing performance metrics like Mystery Shopping/NPS for continuous improvement and close collaboration with Headquarters.

Lead, recruit, and develop an agile, high-performing team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, coaching, and strong team spirit to achieve excellence.

Act as a brand ambassador, upholding the Maison's image, values, and rituals, and ensuring impeccable boutique presentation and representation within the local ecosystem.

Oversee secure and accurate inventory management, maintain visual merchandising standards, and champion the adoption of new retail tools and digital solutions.

Your profile

Minimum of 10 years' experience in luxury goods retail, preferably in luxury watches, with significant managerial experience in sales and customer service.

Demonstrated strong leadership capabilities, including the ability to build trust, motivate teams, delegate effectively, and foster a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

Exceptional client-centric approach, with a deep understanding of luxury client expectations, local clientele in Geneva, and proven experience in clienteling and executing community engagement initiatives.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective cross-functional collaboration, project implementation, and successful change management.

Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset, exhibiting initiative, innovation, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and business growth.

Reliable, independent, and sales-driven, with a poised, composed, and social demeanour, ready to take initiative.

Fluency in English and French is required, with Italian considered a highly advantageous skill.

Why join us

We are a dynamic Maison where the culture is deeply rooted in Collaboration, Shared Accountability and Excellence in Execution. You will partner in an international environment that brings together diverse talents, perspectives, and experiences to drive collective success. We offer the opportunity to continuously learn, grow, and build a fulfilling career within Panerai.

Your recruitment journey

After your application has been selected, our Talent Acquisition team will reach you to conduct an introductory call. Along the process you will have conversations with the hiring manager, key business partners, and members of our executive team.

Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you.

Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai forged its reputation by developing precision instruments and professional watches for the Royal Italian Navy, renowned for their reliability and functional design. Rooted in performance, purpose, and precision, the Maison embraces its heritage while pushing the boundaries of innovation, combining Italian design with Swiss expertise. Today, Panerai continues to create tool watches that serve as trusted companions for every adventure, even in the most demanding environments.

As our next Boutique Manager, you will embark on a pivotal mission to shape the success of our prestigious Geneva boutique. You will develop and optimize the boutique performance and profitability through operational excellence and a refined clienteling strategy, maximizing sales and ensuring every interaction reflects our Maison's standards. As a true ambassador, you will lead, coach, and inspire your team in line with our Maison’s values, fostering talent development for individual career growth and collective team success.

Your impact

•

Drive and exceed global commercial, qualitative, and operational performance objectives through strategic planning, rigorous analysis, and adherence to Maison and Group standards.

Develop and execute market strategies, including in-boutique events and external networking, to enhance commercial opportunities and adapt to local economic environments.

Cultivate strong client loyalty and relationships, particularly with VVIPs, by leveraging CRM tools and fostering a data-driven culture for optimal customer insights.

Ensure impeccable retail execution and operational discipline, utilizing performance metrics like Mystery Shopping/NPS for continuous improvement and close collaboration with Headquarters.

Lead, recruit, and develop an agile, high-performing team, fostering a culture of continuous learning, coaching, and strong team spirit to achieve excellence.

Act as a brand ambassador, upholding the Maison's image, values, and rituals, and ensuring impeccable boutique presentation and representation within the local ecosystem.

Oversee secure and accurate inventory management, maintain visual merchandising standards, and champion the adoption of new retail tools and digital solutions.

Your profile

Minimum of 10 years' experience in luxury goods retail, preferably in luxury watches, with significant managerial experience in sales and customer service.

Demonstrated strong leadership capabilities, including the ability to build trust, motivate teams, delegate effectively, and foster a collaborative, team-oriented environment.

Exceptional client-centric approach, with a deep understanding of luxury client expectations, local clientele in Geneva, and proven experience in clienteling and executing community engagement initiatives.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective cross-functional collaboration, project implementation, and successful change management.

Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset, exhibiting initiative, innovation, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and business growth.

Reliable, independent, and sales-driven, with a poised, composed, and social demeanour, ready to take initiative.

Fluency in English and French is required, with Italian considered a highly advantageous skill.

Why join us

We are a dynamic Maison where the culture is deeply rooted in Collaboration, Shared Accountability and Excellence in Execution. You will partner in an international environment that brings together diverse talents, perspectives, and experiences to drive collective success. We offer the opportunity to continuously learn, grow, and build a fulfilling career within Panerai.

Your recruitment journey

After your application has been selected, our Talent Acquisition team will reach you to conduct an introductory call. Along the process you will have conversations with the hiring manager, key business partners, and members of our executive team.

Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Sustainability Transformation Analyst Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR132092

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

MAIN PURPOSE

The Group Sustainability team has progressed with the consolidation and integration of its Non-Financial Reporting Framework, specifically building on the Swiss Non-Financial Reporting requirements. Looking ahead, the fast-moving Non-Financial Reporting landscape, driven by a growing number of regulatory requirements, entails the ongoing enhancement of non-financial reporting processes. In this context, the Sustainability Transformation team's primary objectives are to oversee the Non-Financial Reporting Framework, and support the continuous improvement of the Group Sustainability Framework.

KEY RESPONSIBILITES

The Sustainability Transformation Analyst Intern will assume a key role in the following areas:

• Provide assistance in the continuous improvement of the Richemont Non-Financial Reporting Framework, ensuring alignment with the GRI and other relevant Standards;
• Support the ESRS gap assessment and the formalisation of improvement plans;
• Support the critical review of GRI disclosures and the ongoing update of required documentation (e.g. GRI Index; Basis of Preparation);
• Support the critical review of regulatory requirements (e.g. CSRD), including benchmark analysis;
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely reporting;
• Support the team in collecting, analysing non-financial information (e.g. content collection template update), conducting data quality check to ensure accuracy and completeness of non-financial reporting;
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting processes and tools, including digital solutions.

SKILLS

• Excellent written and verbal communication
• Self-motivated, strong work ethic, very strong organisational skills
• Proven ability to meet deadlines and work on multiple projects simultaneously
• Excellent attention to detail, thoroughness
• Ability to anticipate needs by being proactive not reactive
• A first experience within the luxury industry is an asset
• Keen interest and understanding of sustainability topics
• Ability to work cross-functionally and build relationships in the Group

PROFILE

• Previous first experience in corporate sustainability preferred
• Master degree in Sustainability, Economics or related field
• Knowledge of GRI, CSRD, ESRS, EU Taxonomy
• Detailed oriented and analytical
• Fluent in English required, good knowledge of French preferred
• Proactive and flexible
• Good command of Excel, MS Project, PowerPoint, Word
• Good communication skills
• Experience working in multi-stakeholder initiatives, whether at University or other

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture
