jobs.title: Group HR Operations Process Manager

titleByLocale.it: Group Risorse Umane Operations Process Manager
titleByLocale.fr: Group Ressources Humaines Operations Process Manager

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133056

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Within Group HR Digital & Data, you will play a key role in strengthening HR Operations Process Excellence across the Group.

Working with Group HR Functional Leads, Group Platforms, People Operation Leaders and regional teams, you will Lead the implementation of HR Operating Model changes, translating strategic direction into practical workflows.

Through process diagnostics, data-driven analysis and continuous improvement execution, you will help make HR Operations processes more efficient, scalable and consistent across the Group. You will translate HR Operations priorities into concrete process improvement, simplification, standardization and automation initiatives.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

Process Diagnostics & Mining

•

Conduct process diagnostics, mapping and mining to identify inefficiencies, duplication and improvement opportunities.

Define and maintain the operational performance framework for HR Operations, leveraging KPIs to assess effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities..

Translate operational insights into practical recommendations that improve service delivery.

Process Optimization

Lead the continuous improvement and standardization of HR Operations processes across the Group, enhancing efficiency, quality and consistency while accommodating justified local regulatory requirements.

Own the HR Operations process improvement backlog, translating business needs into prioritized initiatives and ensuring alignment with Product Owners, Functional Leads and Group Platforms.

Define and maintain HR Operations process standards, documentation and operational guidance to support consistent execution across the Group.

Animate and engage with the global HR Operations community to foster collaboration and knowledge sharing, develop and reinforce common ways of working, identify further improvement opportunities and communicate the roadmap and changes.

Automation & Artificial Intelligence

Identify opportunities to improve HR Operations through automation and AI-enabled capabilities.

Work with the HR Operations Community and Group Platforms to define process requirements and support implementation of automation and AI-enabled improvements.

Promote the practical application of AI to simplify processes, improve quality and reduce manual effort.

Monitor relevant automation and AI opportunities and recommend practical applications that support HR Operations process efficiency.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

A Master’s degree in Human Resources Management or related field.

10+ years experience in HR Operations, Operational Excellence, Business Process Improvement or HR Technology within a complex global organisation.

Strong experience analysing, simplifying and improving operational processes.

Proven ability to apply process improvement methodologies and data-driven problem solving.

Ability to translate analysis into pragmatic, scalable and operationally sustainable solutions.

Strong understanding of HR operating models, process ownership and service delivery environments.

Practical experience with automation and AI-enabled process improvement would be an advantage.

Experience with enterprise HR platforms, preferably Workday, would be an advantage.

Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across Functions, Regions and HR teams.

Fluent English. Knowledge of French is an asset.

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

- We value collegiality, empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity.
- We care for the world we live in.

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

If your application is selected we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Boutique Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133132

We are makers. Thinkers. Strategists. Storytellers. For over 150 years, we’ve been shaped by tradition, powered by progress, and driven by people. Join us as we celebrate the legacy of craftsmanship and the future of watchmaking, where every tick resonates with the heartbeat of time itself. Wherever your path started, we care where you want to go. Whether in Schaffhausen or somewhere else in the world, engineer your next step with us.

CONTEXT

Für unsere Flagship Boutique an der Bahnhofstrasse in Zürich suchen wir einen Boutique Manager (m/w/d).

Ihre Mission:

Als IWC Boutique Manager (m/w/d) sind Sie für die operative Leitung des Tagesgeschäfts sowie für alle damit zusammenhängenden Aktivitäten zur Erreichung der Geschäftsziele verantwortlich. Sie sind eine inspirierende, initiative Führungspersönlichkeit mit einer grossen Leidenschaft für Retail, Servicekultur und unsere Produkte.

Sie führen die Flagship Boutique selbstständig und mit hoher Integrität.

Sie steuern und verantworten den Verkaufsaktivitäten, ein Team von 9 Personen, die Kundenpflege sowie die operativen Abläufe. Zudem spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Verkörperung der Marke IWC, indem Sie unsere Werte aktiv nach innen und aussen repräsentieren.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

Geschäftsentwicklung und operativer Betrieb

• Umsatz und KPI: Konsequente Erreichung von Umsatzzielen und der relevanten KPIs
• Analyse und Massnahmen: Analyse der Performance, Identifizierung geschäftlicher Bedürfnisse und deren Übersetzung in individuelle Massnahmen und Ziele.
• Zusammenarbeit: Aufbau und Pflege einer engen, vertrauensvollen und starken Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, dem Boutique Director sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern.
• Visual Merchandising: Sicherstellung der korrekten Umsetzung der Visual Merchandising Standards.
• Compliance: Sicherstellung, dass alle Abläufe den Unternehmensrichtlinien entsprechen

Kundenerlebnis und -entwicklung

• Vorbildfunktion: Aktive Rolle innerhalb und ausserhalb der Boutique durch die persönliche Betreuung von Kunden sowie die Gewährleistung eines erstklassigen, massgeschneiderten Kundenerlebnisses.
• Kundenbeziehungen: Anleitung des Teams zur exzellenten und professionellen Kundenbetreuung mit dem Ziel, langfristige und starke Beziehungen aufzubauen, die Kundenzufriedenheit zu steigern und die Loyalität zu festigen.
• Netzwerk & Events: Etablierung der Marken- und Boutique-Präsenz im lokalen Markt, Initiierung von Events durch kontinuierliches Networking sowie Gewinnung von Marktanteilen durch gezielte Community-Arbeit.
• CRM-Mentalität: Motivierung des Teams zur Verinnerlichung einer CRM-Mentalität sowie Nutzung von CRM-Tools und -Analysen zur Optimierung des Kundenerlebnisses und Steigerung des Umsatzes.

Teamentwicklung.

• Leadership: Führung des 9-köpfigen Teams als Vorbild durch gelebte Leidenschaft für IWC sowie fundierte Kenntnis unserer Produkte, von Verkaufstechnik, unserer Mission und unserer Werte.
• Schulung: Durchführung von Coaching, In-Store-Trainings und täglichen Briefings.
• Entwicklung: Erstellung, Beurteilung und Diskussion individueller Zielsetzungen und persönlicher Entwicklungspläne für die Mitarbeitenden.
• Feedback und Mitarbeitergespräche: Durchführung von regelmässigen Feedbackgesprächen zur Leistungsbeurteilung und Bereitstellung von konstruktivem Feedback.
• Recruiting: Identifikation und Rekrutierung neuer Talente sowie Zusammenstellung und Bildung eines leistungsstarken Teams

Ihr Profil:

jobs.title: SAP Platform Architect
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133189

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

Our SAP platform is at a pivotal moment; moving to RISE, migrating to s/4, embracing Clean Core, and building the BTP foundations that will power our next decade of innovation. The Platform Architect is the person who connects all these dots: architecture, extensibility, developer enablement, and governance. If you want to shape a global SAP landscape across a portfolio of iconic luxury Maisons, this is the role.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

Within the SAP platform team, the SAP Platform Architect defines and governs the SAP platform architecture across S/4HANA (ERP, EWM, GTS…), SAP BTP, and all integration touchpoints. Shaping the technology landscape, setting guardrails, and ensuring every extension or customisation is justified, sustainable, and future-proof.

You will lead the OSBF Design Authority, promote Clean Core principles and SAP's extensibility strategy (side-by-side vs. in-app), and ensure alignment with both SAP's product roadmap and our enterprise architecture.

Your impact spans across a multi-stream technical roadmap covering 4 strategic pillars:

1. Architecture Vision & Roadmap

• Own and drive the architectural direction of the platform across Core Architecture, BTP & Development.
• Participate in strategic architectural decisions such as use cases for BTP, Federated platforms (Mendix, Tulip, Pega…), ERP/EWM decoupling, S/4HANA continuous evolution, including associated topics such as Job Scheduling or establishing a Printing Platform for the group.
• Collaborate with the Enterprise Architecture team on cross-cutting concerns such as Disaster Recovery design and enterprise-wide technology alignment.
• Evolve the Platform to further integrate CI/CD practices.
• Integrate Richemont AI strategy in the platform roadmap & design.
• Define consumable and reusable services for product teams that accelerate delivery, increase product teams' autonomy, and reduce the need for custom development, duplicated effort, and reliance on central platform expertise.

2. Clean Core Governance & Extensibility Strategy

• Define and enforce Clean Core guidelines: minimise custom code, maximise standard, and leverage key-user extensibility and BTP side-by-side extensions.
• Own the decision framework for "where to extend": in-app (BAdIs, RAP, key-user extensibility) vs. side-by-side (CAP on BTP, Integration Suite, or Federated Platforms).
• Guide product teams on the right extensibility pattern for each use case.
• Conduct architecture reviews for all significant developments.

3. Standards, Patterns & Guardrails

• Integrates Group Standards for reusable architecture patterns, in particular for API design and ownership, event-driven integration, data models, CDS views, and Fiori apps.
• Champion configuration as Code for sap platforms, including BTP (Terraform) which adheres to Richemont guidelines in terms of security, Identity management and connectivity.
• Publish and maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and reference architectures.
• Guide the technical archiving and data volume management strategy and application retirement (ILM).
• Provide architectural direction on data lifecycle decisions that impact platform performance, storage costs, and compliance.

4. Community & Enablement

• Participate in cross-team design reviews and lead the SAP platform Architecture Board.
• Establish and animate an Architect Community across the product teams.
• Stay ahead of SAP technology evolution through continuous learning, SAP community engagement, and vendor dialogue.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

Education & Experience

• 10+ years of progressive experience in SAP ecosystems, with deep expertise across S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and hybrid integration landscapes.
• 3+ years in an SAP platform architecture role.
• Master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Expertise

jobs.title: Revenue Growth & Performance Project Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133161

Founded in Florence in 1860, Panerai forged its reputation by developing precision instruments and professional watches for the Royal Italian Navy, renowned for their reliability and functional design. Rooted in performance, purpose, and precision, the Maison embraces its heritage while pushing the boundaries of innovation, combining Italian design with Swiss expertise. Today, Panerai continues to create tool watches that serve as trusted companions for every adventure, even in the most demanding environments.

As our next Revenue Growth & Performance Project Manager (Americas), you will take a leading role in driving regional revenue growth by transforming strategic insights into impactful initiatives. Working across functions and markets, you will lead complex projects, influence key stakeholders and deliver measurable results in support of both regional and global business ambitions.

Your impact

Strategic Growth & Project Leadership - Americas

•

Identify and drive revenue growth opportunities across key commercial levers, translating insights into actionable initiatives.

Lead cross-functional projects with Americas markets and key functions, ensuring effective execution and measurable results.

Build and manage a strong pipeline of growth initiatives, tracking progress against defined KPIs and financial targets.

Performance Monitoring & Business Partnership - Americas

Partner with Americas markets to monitor commercial performance, challenge existing approaches and drive improvement opportunities through data-driven insights.

Drive regional performance reviews and ensure alignment between global strategy and local market execution.

Key Global Projects

Optimize pricing through strategic project leadership, market analysis, and performance monitoring, collaborating with Regional Project Managers.

Enhance operational excellence and customer experience across networks by driving retailization projects with Partners.

Implement Market Business plans and initiatives, overseeing their development in collaboration with Regional Project Managers.

Protect brand image and pricing integrity by developing and executing comprehensive strategies to address Grey Market challenges.

Your profile

You are a seasoned project and business professional with a strong commercial mindset and exposure to international environments.

You bring:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or related field.

10+ years of progressive experience in project management, business development or commercial excellence, ideally within an international retail or luxury environment.

A proven ability to lead complex cross-functional, manage multiple priorities and deliver measurable business impact.

Strong analytical and financial acumen with experience in financial modelling, business case development, and translating complex data into actionable recommendations.

Experience in financial modeling, business case development, and performance tracking.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across functions and levels.

Fluency in English, with additional regional languages (e.g. French) considered an asset; proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.

Why join us?

We are a dynamic Maison where our culture is deeply rooted in Collaboration, Shared Accountability and Excellence in Execution. You will thrive in an international environment that brings together diverse talents, perspectives, and experiences to drive collective success. We offer opportunities to continuously learn, grow and build a fulfilling career within Panerai.

Your recruitment journey

After your application has been selected, our HR team will reach you to conduct an introductory call. Along the process you will have conversations with the hiring manager, key business partners, and members of our executive team.

Your next adventure starts at Panerai. We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Responsable SSSE
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133229

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

YOUR MISSION:
Mettre en œuvre une culture sécurité globale au sein du site.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

Garantir la santé et la sécurité des personnes

• Piloter, déployer et analyser la démarche d’identification des risques au poste de travail
• Proposer un plan de progrès en cohérence avec les objectifs stratégiques, tactiques et opérationnels de l’entreprise
• Être garant de la conformité réglementaire du site
• Construire les modules de formation et animer la formation de tous les collaborateurs sur les risques santé et accidents (yc externes).
• Piloter et participer à la réalisation des audits SST dans l'entreprise.
• Encadrer les démarches EHSS d’externes
• Mettre en place un système de traçabilité des accidents, incidents survenus et des situations à risques. Superviser la mise en place des mesures correctives nécessaires.
• Suivre et s’assurer de l’avancement des plans d’actions liés à la santé des personnes (gestion des risques, audits, incidents, remontées spontanées).
• Développer et diffuser une culture globale HSE visant à réduire les accidents / maladies / troubles associés à la place de travail ou dans le cadre extra professionnel.
• Mettre en place et contrôler l’organisation en cas d'urgence (détection, réaction, évacuation, dossier pompier, supporter la direction dans la gestion de crise).
• Superviser le on/off boardings des collaborateurs (badges accès, formation / information de base etc).

Garantir la sûreté des personnes et des biens

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les agents de loge
• Mettre en place et maintenir un concept (yc installations) de sûreté en fonction des activités de la manufacture et des normes groupe et gérer la diffusion globale des règles en vigueur et la formation des collaborateurs.
• Gérer le système effraction et le système de contrôles des accès, les accès aux coffres, la vidéosurveillance.

Garantir la réduction de notre empreinte carbone.

• Réaliser l’analyse environnementale selon la méthodologie du groupe et proposer une politique environnementale cohérente avec l’ensemble de notre écosystème.
• Mettre en place le suivi des déchets et proposer des solutions de réduction.
• Être le garant du respect des normes de protection de l’environnement.
• Assurer le contact avec les autorités compétentes. (SENE, commune. ).
• Veiller au maintien à jour de la liste des produits chimiques et proposer des produits de substitution.
• Piloter et suivre les indicateurs environnementaux (déchets, COV.) et les consommations énergétiques.
• Proposer des optimisations de fonctionnement de nos installations (HVAC, air comprimé…)

Management de l’activité

• Animer des comités managers
• Participer aux réunions externes organisées au sein du groupe

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• Formation suisse impérative dans le domaine de la sécurité (brevet fédéral ou autre équivalent, ou reconnaissance de diplôme étranger en cours)
• Aisance relationnelle
• Communication orale impactante
• Bon niveau rédactionnelle
• Esprit de synthèse et fédérateur

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Technicien méthodes
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133216
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

Au sein du département Etudes et Méthodes Traditionnelles, vous participez au développement des nouveaux produits horlogers, en modélisant et créent les plans des nouveaux produits et/ou des outillages, en intégrant les contraintes techniques selon le cahier des charges défini.

COMMENT AUREZ-VOUS UN IMPACT ?

• Etablir des plans de fabrication à partir du dossier technique

jobs.title: Client Advisor
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133253

Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen.

At the pinnacle of Haute Horlogerie and understated elegance, the Maison creates timepieces with unique technical and aesthetic signatures, and an extremely high level of finishing touches.

FOR THOSE WHO SEEK EXCELLENCE

Join a community of dedicated professionals where excellence is both a given and a never-ending quest. Play your part in driving our collective success.

YOUR ROLE

We are seeking a passionate and dynamic Client Advisor for our Geneva boutique who will be responsible for delivering a highly personalized, premium client experience. In this role, you will demonstrate expertise with curiosity and humility, connecting with both local and international guests to create true, long-term relationships.

You will act as a key brand ambassador, sharing your passion for Haute Horlogerie and turning valued clients into loyal friends of the Maison while consistently striving to achieve commercial objectives.

If you are energized by a fast-paced environment where collaboration, craftsmanship, and storytelling drive success, we invite you to join us.

PLAYING YOUR PART

• Elevating the Client Experience: You will deliver an exceptional, warm, and unique in-store journey, ensuring every visitor feels welcomed with absolute humility and attentiveness. By mastering all key moments of our sales ceremony, you will ask the right questions to understand client aspirations, tailor solutions, and build deep, lasting relationships. You will proactively cultivate your client portfolio, capturing client data effectively to implement bespoke follow-up and clienteling strategies.
• Driving Sales Performance: You will drive sales performance by consistently working to achieve and exceed boutique turnover targets. With agility and commercial drive, you will handle negotiations and objections with ease, maximizing upselling and cross-selling opportunities while strictly following retail guidelines. You will also provide flawless support to after-sales clients, acting as a trusted referent and recommending solutions that uphold our high service standards.
• Acting as a Brand Ambassador: With a genuine passion for luxury and craftsmanship, you will represent the Maison’s rich heritage and values both inside and outside the boutique. You will share Vacheron Constantin’s unique stories with enthusiasm, demonstrating deep knowledge of our collections, movements, and technical materials. You will actively support boutique events and activations, serving as an influential contact in the local luxury market.
• Ensuring Operational Excellence: You will contribute to flawless daily boutique operations by assisting with setup, breakdown, and maintaining visual merchandising standards. You will participate in inventory management, cycle counts, and compliance procedures to ensure successful audits, while collaborating seamlessly with colleagues and supporting back-office projects as needed.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL?

• Proven Experience: At least 5 years of successful experience in luxury goods retail (Fine Watchmaking or Jewelry preferred) or high-end luxury hospitality.
• Sales Acumen: An excellent sales track record with proven experience working in a target-driven, fast-paced retail environment with a results-oriented mindset.
• CRM & Action Plans: Strong ability to confidently navigate through CRM databases to extract client insights, track behaviors, and build solid, proactive client action plans.
• IT & Administration: Highly organized with strong attention to detail, a high degree of professionalism, and excellent literacy with digital devices, including being fully at ease with MS Office tools.
• Communication & Languages: Excellent communication, interpersonal, and storytelling skills. Fluency in French and English is required; additional languages (such as Arabic, Chinese, Russian, or German) are a strong plus.
• Mindset & Behavioral Competencies:
• Passion: A profound appreciation for the luxury watch industry, craftsmanship, and Vacheron Constantin's heritage.
• Humility & Empathy: A patient, warm, and welcoming attitude, showing emotional intelligence and resilience under all circumstances.
• Agility: The ability to present ideas clearly, adapt to a diverse clientele, and find creative solutions that satisfy both the client and the Maison.
• Collegiality: A true team player who cooperates naturally, supports colleagues, and welcomes team challenges.
• Curiosity: An inherent desire to continuously learn about our history, products, and evolving market trends.

HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING?

Vacheron Constantin celebrates 270 years as the world’s oldest watchmaker in continuous production since 1755. Headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, we operate a global retail network of nearly 200 points of sale across 36 countries. Every member of our exceptional global community of watchmakers, artisans and dedicated professionals share a common devotion to our exceptional heritage and a passion to trailblaze an even brighter future.

If this sparks your imagination, we welcome your application.

Founded in 1755, Vacheron Constantin is the world’s oldest watch Manufacture in continuous production for more than 270 years, faithfully perpetuating a proud heritage of watchmaking excellence and stylistic sophistication through generations of master craftsmen.

jobs.title: Apprenti Horloger de production CFC
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133324
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique.

Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ?

Missions

Dès la rentrée d’août 2027, vous vous formerez pendant 3 ans pour obtenir votre Certificat Fédéral de Capacité d’Horloger·ère de production. Au cours de votre apprentissage, vous développerez vos compétences techniques et découvrirez différents domaines de l’horlogerie.

Au cours de cette formation, vous développerez vos compétences en travaillant sur une diversité de modèles de montres, tout en acquérant des savoir-faire essentiels en matière d'efficacité et de productivité.

Responsabilités

• Maîtriser l'assemblage de mouvements horlogers variés : mécaniques, automatiques, à quartz et chronographes
• S'initier aux techniques fondamentales de la micromécanique, incluant le limage, le tournage de précision (sur tour 70), la métrologie, le fraisage, le perçage, ainsi que les traitements thermiques (trempe et revenu)
• Acquérir les compétences en habillage : pose du cadran et des aiguilles, emboîtage, ajustement du bracelet et montage des boîtes
• Se former aux opérations spécifiques de pivotage, de réglage et d'achevage des mouvements
• Participer à divers stages pratiques au sein de nos ateliers et auprès d'entreprises partenaires

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

• Bonne maitrise du français à l'oral comme à l'écrit permettant de réussir sa formation professionnelle
• Excellentes aptitudes en mathématique et intérêt pour les raisonnements logiques et techniques
• Intérêt et curiosité et motivation pour les produits horlogers et les mécanismes de précision
• Dextérité manuelle, autonomie et rigueur
• Faculté de concentration, patience et raisonnement logique
• Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle

VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS

Si vous êtes motivé·e, nous serons ravis d'étudier votre dossier de candidature complet, qui sera examiné par nos équipes de recrutement et de formation. Si votre profil retient notre attention, vous serez convié·e à une journée découverte.

À l'issue de cette première étape, et si votre intérêt pour les métiers de l'horlogerie se confirme, nous vous inviterons à une journée de recrutement axée sur divers tests pratiques et théoriques.

Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ?

Missions

Dès la rentrée d’août 2027, vous vous formerez pendant 3 ans pour obtenir votre Certificat Fédéral de Capacité d’Horloger·ère de production. Au cours de votre apprentissage, vous développerez vos compétences techniques et découvrirez différents domaines de l’horlogerie.

Au cours de cette formation, vous développerez vos compétences en travaillant sur une diversité de modèles de montres, tout en acquérant des savoir-faire essentiels en matière d'efficacité et de productivité.

Responsabilités

• Maîtriser l'assemblage de mouvements horlogers variés : mécaniques, automatiques, à quartz et chronographes
• S'initier aux techniques fondamentales de la micromécanique, incluant le limage, le tournage de précision (sur tour 70), la métrologie, le fraisage, le perçage, ainsi que les traitements thermiques (trempe et revenu)
• Acquérir les compétences en habillage : pose du cadran et des aiguilles, emboîtage, ajustement du bracelet et montage des boîtes
• Se former aux opérations spécifiques de pivotage, de réglage et d'achevage des mouvements
• Développer des notions en pendulerie
• Participer à divers stages pratiques au sein de nos ateliers et auprès d'entreprises partenaires

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

• Excellentes maitrises des acquis scolaires et une capacité d’apprentissage avérées sont requise pour mener à bien la formation professionnelle
• Excellentes aptitudes en mathématique et intérêt pour les raisonnements logiques et techniques
• Intérêt et curiosité et motivation pour les produits horlogers et les mécanismes de précision
• Dextérité manuelle, autonomie et rigueur
• Faculté de concentration, patience et raisonnement logique
• Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle

descriptionByLocale.en:
Reference code: JR133325
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique.

Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ?

Missions

Dès la rentrée d’août 2027, vous vous formerez pendant 3 ans pour obtenir votre Certificat Fédéral de Capacité d’Horloger·ère de production. Au cours de votre apprentissage, vous développerez vos compétences techniques et découvrirez différents domaines de l’horlogerie.

Au cours de cette formation, vous développerez vos compétences en travaillant sur une diversité de modèles de montres, tout en acquérant des savoir-faire essentiels en matière d'efficacité et de productivité.

Responsabilités

• Maîtriser l'assemblage de mouvements horlogers variés : mécaniques, automatiques, à quartz et chronographes
• S'initier aux techniques fondamentales de la micromécanique, incluant le limage, le tournage de précision (sur tour 70), la métrologie, le fraisage, le perçage, ainsi que les traitements thermiques (trempe et revenu)
• Acquérir les compétences en habillage : pose du cadran et des aiguilles, emboîtage, ajustement du bracelet et montage des boîtes
• Se former aux opérations spécifiques de pivotage, de réglage et d'achevage des mouvements
• Développer des notions en pendulerie
• Participer à divers stages pratiques au sein de nos ateliers et auprès d'entreprises partenaires

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

• Excellentes maitrises des acquis scolaires et une capacité d’apprentissage avérées sont requise pour mener à bien la formation professionnelle
• Excellentes aptitudes en mathématique et intérêt pour les raisonnements logiques et techniques
• Intérêt et curiosité et motivation pour les produits horlogers et les mécanismes de précision
• Dextérité manuelle, autonomie et rigueur
• Faculté de concentration, patience et raisonnement logique
• Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle

VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS

Si vous êtes motivé·e, nous serons ravis d'étudier votre dossier de candidature complet, qui sera examiné par nos équipes de recrutement et de formation. Si votre profil retient notre attention, vous serez convié·e à une journée découverte.

À l'issue de cette première étape, et si votre intérêt pour les métiers de l'horlogerie se confirme, nous vous inviterons à une journée de recrutement axée sur divers tests pratiques et théoriques.

Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier.

jobs.title: Associate Watch Advisor
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133371

Since the legend's reincarnation in 1994, A. Lange & Söhne has been one of the most respected and successful watch brands in the luxury sector. Our whole aim is to continue our tradition with new, outstanding products, very much in keeping with Lange's claim: State-of-the-art tradition. What we expect from our watches, we expect from us: Never stand still.

PURPOSE

As an Ambassador of A. Lange & Söhne inside and outside the boutique, the mission of the Associate Watch Advisor is to provide an excellent customer experience. Working within a professional and exciting team, the purpose of the job is to attain desired results through creative and effective use of resources and retail and CRM tools (iCM), prepare monthly action plans to achieve sales targets in order to meet or exceed personal monthly sales objective, while managing all steps of the sales process and offer an exclusive customer service in line with brand guidelines.

This position will support our future Flagship Boutique in Geneva, opening early 2027.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SALES

• Meet personal budgets in accordance with brand retail strategy (compliance with group procedures, legal, fiscal, and customs regulations).
• Maximize profit whist controlling & minimizing costs (discount, general expenses, third party commissions).
• Regularly analyze and question missed confirmed sales with Assistant/Boutique Manager, to further refine future sales projections.
• Organize private viewing with potential VIPs in your region.
• Discuss business opportunities/Action Plans of potential prospects with Assistant/Boutique Manager.
• Act as a reference in terms of building action plans to achieve personal targets.

BRAND AMBASSADORSHIP

• Ensure Excellency within and outside of the boutique.
• Ensure maximum client welcoming, handling, and servicing.
• Keep learning about the products and brand and become a reference person for the Maison.
• Demonstrate brand ambassadorial skills, at any given time, with clients, Top VIPs & any third party.
• Responsible for overall appearance and maintenance of the boutique in accordance to brand guidelines and concept.
• Assist in timely boutique implementation and control of any new Visual Merchandizing concepts.

CUSTOMER & CRM RELATED ACTIVITIES

• Ensure Service Excellency within the boutique at all time and with any boutique clients
• Be part of a positive atmosphere within the boutique; optimistic, constructive, helpful, confident, etc.
• Proactively participate of regular VIP and orders, considerate of our boutique opportunities.
• Ensure accurate and genuine relationship building with customers.
• Ensure attention to existing and new recruitment of VIP, customer and prospect database for boutique sales and marketing activities.
• Individually handle with care client complaints, and immediately report to Assistant/Boutique Manager brand product related issues.
• Follow up and coordinate individual repairs and after sales related matters with Sales Administrators.

STORE OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT

• Actively taking his part in monthly (quarterly, yearly) stocktaking.
• Actively ensuring all measures to avoid stock discrepancies at all times.
• Automatic replenishment of sold timepieces and active order requests.
• Ensuring a proper maintenance of all boutique timepieces when necessary: organize changing of straps polishing, servicing, etc.

FINANCIAL & CASH REGISTER CONTROL

• Compliance with procedures, and with legal, fiscal and customs regulations.
• Mastering dealing with credit card transaction of considerable amounts, Cash Register, etc.

REPORTING

• Ensure timely reporting of any opportunity, incident, etc to Assistant/Boutique Manager.
• Share new practices, ideas with Assistant/Boutique Manager to enhance boutique operations as a whole.

TEAM WORK

• Share new ideas, work related practices & knowledge with boutique’s members, office colleagues.
• Monitor own appearance and behavior, in line with company policy and boutique guidelines (uniform, makeup, language, hair, accessories, etc).
• Full and complete assistance to shift colleague during the sales ceremony.
• Active participation in Boutique trainings and role-plays to improve knowledge and client experience.

WHAT WE OFFER

• An attractive compensation and benefits program
• A small, dynamic, and caring team
• A role with a wide range of tasks and responsibilities
• A work environment where we value collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity
• Continuous learning and development opportunities

jobs.title: Product Development Product Owner
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133383

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

“Do you enjoy orchestrating evolutions towards operational efficiency and future-ready customer and employee experiences? Are you eager to use the latest technologies and participate to the build of constantly improving solutions? If yes, then apply and join us. A team aiming at accelerating business through technology is waiting for you to step up and have an impact on our Group transformation”

YOUR MISSION:

As part of the Group Platforms department, Richemont is looking to strengthen a very dynamic Product Management team. This Product team is structured around key capabilities that support our Maisons’ value chain strategy.

The Product Development Product Owner will be the interface between the Group Maisons, Central Functions, other Product teams and the technical teams delivering the solutions supporting the business needs related to product development within the product organization framework.

He/She will ensure the proper capture of product development related needs (evolution, enrichment, cutover support, etc.), perform the discovery and analysis along technical teams of the requirements, prioritize the requests based on their business value, opportunities and time criticality. He/she will ensure the delivery of those requests by technical teams following an agile framework, working closely with Group Technology counterparts forming the Product & Process Development Product Team.

Working alongside other Product owners, he/she will facilitate the coordination of other Product teams and their Product Development related needs.

He/she will also lead or support initiatives to increase the maturity level on product development flow, from harmonization of rules and practices to the deployment of new tools and processes.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

• You will maintain and refine product backlog based on changing needs according to business value or ROI, given capacity available.
• You will partner with the Technology teams to make sure the product vision is translated appropriately into the implementation.
• You will align with cross-functional teams to manage cross-product dependencies.
• You will work with the Product Team to ensure selected technologies match business requirements expressed by business stakeholders (Maisons, Functions, Regions/countries)
• You will be responsible for product adoption, delivering product training support, and documents.
• You will support business performing change management and sharing best practices.
• You will conduct regular updates to share how the product is evolving and to demonstrate how it contributes to the business vision and to the success of Richemont and its Maisons.

jobs.title: Assistant Boutique Manager
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133372

Since the legend's reincarnation in 1994, A. Lange & Söhne has been one of the most respected and successful watch brands in the luxury sector. Our whole aim is to continue our tradition with new, outstanding products, very much in keeping with Lange's claim: State-of-the-art tradition. What we expect from our watches, we expect from us: Never stand still.

PURPOSE

Managing day-to-day boutique operations, transforming corporate objectives into operational goals at a boutique level. Being the brand ambassador to reflect brand image to boutique customers. Attain desired results through creative and effective use of resources, retail and CRM tools. Prepare business analysis and action plans to achieve sales targets. Assist the boutique manager in his/her role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SALES

• Meet personal budgets in accordance with brand retail strategy (compliance with group procedures, legal, fiscal, and customs regulations).
• Maximize profit whist controlling & minimizing costs (discount, general expenses, third party commissions).
• Regularly analyze and question missed confirmed sales with Assistant/Boutique Manager, to further refine future sales projections.
• Organize private viewing with potential VIPs in your region.
• Discuss business opportunities/Action Plans of potential prospects with Assistant/Boutique Manager.
• Act as a reference in terms of building action plans to achieve personal targets.
• Assist boutique manager in exceeding boutique budgets in accordance with brand retail strategy (compliance with group procedures, legal, fiscal, and customs regulations).
• Achieve Boutique KPIs defined by Boutique Manager and/or regional brand manager.
• Learn and support the boutique manager with implementing HQ commercial guidelines (Retail Manual).
• Support the preparation and delivery of monthly boutique meetings and follow-up actions.
• Analyze each boutique visit with concerned sales member and build action plan to for possible conversion/retention.

TEAM MANAGEMENT

• Act as a manager-on-duty when the boutique manager is absent
• Identify and share with the boutique manager the training needs of boutique members.
• Ensure monthly staff programs are planned and communicated to boutique manager.
• Responsible for supporting the boutique manager in integrating and training new and existing team members.
• Monitor staff appearances and behavior, in line with company policy and boutique guidelines (uniform, makeup, language, hair, accessories, etc).
• Provide support to boutique manager in coaching of each boutique member and collective objectives, via (not limited to) team meetings, on the job trainings, assignment of tasks, and feedback on expectations.
• Organize boutique team schedules and solve conflicts, to ensure work equality of staff in terms of working hours and opportunities.

STORE MANAGEMENT

• Ensure Excellence in at outside of the boutique.
• Ensure maximum client welcoming, handling, and servicing.
• Demonstrate brand ambassadorial skills, at any given time, with partners or local dignitaries.
• Responsible for overall appearance and maintenance of the boutique in accordance to brand guidelines and concept.
• Assist in timely boutique implementation and control of any new Visual Merchandizing concepts.

STORE OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT

• Learn and practice compliance with Group and Brand (Retail Manual) procedures.
• Act as a manager-on-duty when the boutique manager is absent.
• Actively ensure accuracy of monthly (quarterly, yearly) stocktaking and quality control.
• Actively ensuring all measures to avoid stock discrepancies at all times.
• Ensuring maintenance of all boutique timepieces when necessary: changing of straps polishing, servicing, etc.
• Weekly follow up with regional head office for stock replenishments and active order requests.

FINANCIAL & CASH REGISTER CONTROL

• Compliance with procedures, and with legal, fiscal and customs regulations.
• Control cash register.

REPORTING

• Ensure timely reporting of sales (daily, monthly) in accordance with boutique brand and sales manager.
• Identify strengths and weaknesses in existing operation to define action plans for implementation.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE & CRM RELATED ACTIVITIES

• Support and ensure the boutique team confidently delivers Lange selling ceremony.
• Be part of a positive atmosphere within the boutique; optimistic, constructive, helpful, confident, etc.
• Proactively participate in VIP events and orders, be considerate of our boutique opportunities.
• Ensure accurate and genuine relationship building with customers.
• Ensure attention to existing and new recruitment of VIP, customer and prospect database for boutique sales and marketing activities.
• Individually handle with care client complaints, and immediately report to Assistant/Boutique Manager brand product related issues.
• Follow up and coordinate individual repairs and after sales related matters with Sales Administrators.

WHAT WE OFFER

• An attractive compensation and benefits program
• A small, dynamic, and caring team
• A role with a wide range of tasks and responsibilities
• A work environment where we value collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity
• Continuous learning and development opportunities

Managing day-to-day boutique operations, transforming corporate objectives into operational goals at a boutique level. Being the brand ambassador to reflect brand image to boutique customers. Assist the boutique manager in his/her role.

SALES

• Meet personal budgets in accordance with brand retail strategy (compliance with group procedures, legal, fiscal, and customs regulations).

• Organize private viewing with potential VIPs in your region.

• Act as a reference in terms of building action plans to achieve personal targets.

• Achieve Boutique KPIs defined by Boutique Manager and/or regional brand manager.

• Support the preparation and delivery of monthly boutique meetings and follow-up actions.
• Analyze each boutique visit with concerned sales member and build action plan to for possible conversion/retention.

• Act as a manager-on-duty when the boutique manager is absent
• Identify and share with the boutique manager the training needs of boutique members.
• Ensure monthly staff programs are planned and communicated to boutique manager.

• Monitor staff appearances and behavior, in line with company policy and boutique guidelines (uniform, makeup, language, hair, accessories, etc).
• Provide support to boutique manager in coaching of each boutique member and collective objectives, via (not limited to) team meetings, on the job trainings, assignment of tasks, and feedback on expectations.

• Ensure Excellence in at outside of the boutique.
• Ensure maximum client welcoming, handling, and servicing.
• Demonstrate brand ambassadorial skills, at any given time, with partners or local dignitaries.

• Act as a manager-on-duty when the boutique manager is absent.

• Actively ensuring all measures to avoid stock discrepancies at all times.
• Ensuring maintenance of all boutique timepieces when necessary: changing of straps polishing, servicing, etc.
• Weekly follow up with regional head office for stock replenishments and active order requests.

• Compliance with procedures, and with legal, fiscal and customs regulations.
• Control cash register.

• Ensure timely reporting of sales (daily, monthly) in accordance with boutique brand and sales manager.
• Identify strengths and weaknesses in existing operation to define action plans for implementation.

• Follow up and coordinate individual repairs and after sales related matters with Sales Administrators.

• A small, dynamic, and caring team
• A role with a wide range of tasks and responsibilities
• A work environment where we value collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity
• Continuous learning and development opportunities

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133422

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced HR Business Partner to join our Cartier Switzerland team.

This pivotal role will position you as a partner for our boutiques and Retail leadership, actively contributing to the definition and execution of our HR strategy in service of Cartier’s commercial success.

Key Responsibilities:

• Partnership & Expert Advice: Act as a trusted HR advisor and partner to Retail leadership, translating business priorities into concrete and effective HR initiatives. Provide expert guidance on all HR matters, including Swiss labor law, talent acquisition, HR policies, performance management, and skills development.
• Talent Lifecycle Management: Drive the entire talent lifecycle for our boutique employees, including recruitment, performance management, talent reviews and development, salary review processes, and succession planning, to strengthen our Retail teams' capabilities and enhance retention.
• Data-Driven HR & Operations: Utilize HR Information Systems (such as Workday and SAP) to optimize processes and adopt an analytical approach to interpret HR data. Provide data-driven recommendations to improve HR effectiveness and contribute to business outcomes, including budget planning and headcount control.
• Cultural Leadership & Change Management: Promote a performance-driven, diverse, and inclusive culture within Cartier. Lead and implement local and international HR projects, driving and executing impactful HR change management initiatives across the boutique network.
• Boutique Proximity & Collaboration: Ensure strong proximity and close collaboration with our boutique teams, involving regular travel across Switzerland (minimum 30%) to understand their needs and provide on-the-ground support.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?

• A minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in a HRBP role.
• Demonstrated experience within the luxury industry, with a strong understanding of the retail environment being a significant asset.
• Proven ability to effectively manage diverse stakeholders and build strong relationships in a multicultural setting.
• Proficiency in HR Information Systems (HRIS), including Workday and SAP, coupled with advanced Excel skills.
• A detail-oriented approach combined with a strong drive for results.
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate effectively.
• In-depth knowledge and practical application of Swiss labor law.
• Fluency in both French and English is essential; proficiency in German or Italian is a distinct advantage.
• Ability to travel up to 30 % of the time

Still wondering why, you should apply?

• You will join a friendly and dynamic team with whom you will be able to share your knowledge and expertise
• Entrepreneurship, trust, integrity and agile learning are part of our great team spirit
• You will interact with numerous stakeholders across Maisons, Functions

WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.

• We value freedom, collegiality, loyalty, and solidarity
• We foster empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity
• We care for the world we live in.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133496
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

WE WELCOME

We are looking for a talented Sales Associate (12-month contract) who wants to join one of the legendary boutique, Cartier Zürich, and contribute to the success and growth of one of our main boutiques.

YOU WILL BE

An Ambassador of Cartier and will become your second nature in the Boutique and at external Client events. You will have the mission to deliver an outstanding service to high value guests while making them feel at home in our Boutique.

By proactively building a strong relationship with your Client’s portfolio, you will guide them across our Creations to deliver unique Client experience. Thanks to your team spirit, working towards individual targets as well as making a key difference to the shared team objectives will be your two main goals. Your contribution will be key to a seamless and smooth running of the Boutique operations.

The unique nature of our client's boutique means you have a realistic opportunity to deliver an amazing experience for guests. Our client can provide outstanding product training and development, but we need the passion, commitment and drive from you.

YOU ARE

Passionate and excel in understanding luxury client needs. You are delighted to cherish a true relationship with your Clients. As you will first join a team, you’re excited to create great energy with your team members. You will be welcomed by a friendly and open-minded and diverse team that focuses on providing an ultra-personal service. Each of them have unique skills, competencies and different background that you will learn from.

If you have a relevant experience of working in and succeeding in a Luxury Watch or Jewelry retail environment, you have a strong interpersonal and sales skills, you speak fluently English & German and you have a positive energy, then this challenge will be perfect for you!

APPLY NOW IF YOU ARE THE UNIQUE TALENT WE ARE LOOKING FOR!

The unique nature of our client's boutique means you have a realistic opportunity to deliver an amazing experience for guests. Our client can provide outstanding product training and development, but we need the passion, commitment and drive from you.

YOU ARE

Passionate and excel in understanding luxury client needs. You are delighted to cherish a true relationship with your Clients. As you will first join a team, you’re excited to create great energy with your team members. You will be welcomed by a friendly and open-minded and diverse team that focuses on providing an ultra-personal service. Each of them have unique skills, competencies and different background that you will learn from.

If you have a relevant experience of working in and succeeding in a Luxury Watch or Jewelry retail environment, you have a strong interpersonal and sales skills, you speak fluently English & German and you have a positive energy, then this challenge will be perfect for you!

APPLY NOW IF YOU ARE THE UNIQUE TALENT WE ARE LOOKING FOR!

jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133497
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique. Nous sommes convaincus que des perspectives variées nourrissent l'innovation et nous encouragent à créer des expériences exceptionnelles.

Nous vous offrons un environnement stimulant et l’opportunité de contribuer, par votre vision personnelle, à un héritage de créativité.

Nous célébrons toutes les réussites, quelles qu’elles soient, favorisant ainsi des liens significatifs fondés sur la gratitude et le soutien mutuel et cultivant un fort sentiment d'appartenance.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT

Mission

Nous recherchons un Chef de groupe usinage pour renforcer notre équipement de management au sein de l’équipe de nuit pour notre site de Villars-sur-Glâne.

Responsabilités

Pour 50% de votre taux d’activité, vous assurez la gestion quotidienne du secteur en termes de management d’équipe, de technique, de qualité, de productivité, de délai ainsi que la mise en place de nouveaux produits :

•

Vous organisez de façon optimale votre département, évaluer la performance, développer les potentiels et l'expertise pour fédérer et retenir

Vous êtes le relais de communication auprès de vos collaborateurs et promouvoir les valeurs de la Maison

Vous contribuez à développer une ambiance de travail saine et stimulante

Vous veillez à l’application de l’ensemble des règles d'Hygiène et de Sécurité et au suivi de la gestion administrative de votre équipe

Vous assurez le maintien des processus et des moyens existants et participez à la mise en place des nouveaux processus de fabrication

Vous veillez au partage des informations auprès des différents partenaires et de votre équipe

Vous assurez le suivi de la production et préparer le reporting de votre secteur

Vous êtes force de propositions pour améliorer la production (ergonomie, flux, méthode, outils, qualité)

Vous mettez en place et gérez l'auto-contrôle

Vous analysez les problèmes de non-conformité rencontrés et mettez en place les actions correctives en partenariat avec les équipes Qualité et Méthodes

Vous participez à la résolution de problèmes de votre secteur

Pour 50% de votre taux d’activité, vous êtes acteur de la production:

Vous produisez et vous vous efforcez à maintenir, soutenir et améliorer les performances Qualité, Livraison et Productivité de votre secteur

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

Au bénéfice d’un CFC polymécanicien ou Micromécanicien ou d’un Diplôme de Technicien·ne ES en microtechniques vous avez plusieurs années d’expérience dans l’industrie ainsi que la maîtrise des processus d’usinage.

Vous connaissez les outils informatiques et ERP et connaissez des outils de gestion, de planification et des indicateurs de performance.

L’autonomie est une force chez vous. Vous êtes par ailleurs, agile, capable de conduire le changement et bénéficiez d’une bonne résistance au stress.

Doté de bonnes capacités de communication, de pédagogie, et d’un sens de l’écoute, vous êtes capable de fédérer les équipes.

Enfin, vous êtes une personne rigoureuse, responsable et dotée d’un esprit pro-actif

VOTRE EXPERIENCE AVEC NOUS

Si votre candidature correspond à ce que l'on recherche, vous aurez un premier contact téléphonique au plus vite avec notre équipe RH.

Par la suite, un entretien individuel avec notre Responsable fabrication ainsi que notre HR Business Partner sera organisé.

Écrivez la prochaine étape de votre histoire avec Cartier.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ?

Missions

Dès la rentrée d’août 2027, vous vous formerez pendant 4 ans pour obtenir votre Certificat Fédéral de Capacité de Polymécanicien·ne. Au cours de votre apprentissage, vous développerez vos compétences techniques et découvrirez différents domaines de la mécanique, en fonction des activités et des opportunités de formation.

Pendant cette formation, vous apprendrez à fabriquer des pièces précises, uniques ou en prototype. Vous utiliserez des machines conventionnelles et des machines CNC (à commandes numériques). Vous développerez des compétences en programmation de ces machines, et la maîtrise de différentes techniques (exemple : d'érosion à fil ou par plongée).

Responsabilités

• Réaliser des assemblages mécaniques complets
• Réaliser des opérations d’usinage sur machines conventionnelles et CNC
• Programmer et utiliser des machines CNC
• Contrôler la qualité des pièces produites
• Identifier et analyser les éventuels défauts
• Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus de production
• Collaborer avec les différents métiers et départements

CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS

• Bon niveau de français à l'oral comme à l'écrit permettant de réussir sa formation professionnelle
• Bonnes aptitudes en mathématique et intérêt pour les raisonnements logiques et techniques
• Intérêt, curiosité et motivation pour la mécanique de précision, la technique et l'horlogerie (une expérience de stage dans ce domaine serait un atout)
• Dextérité manuelle, minutie et souci du détail
• Autonomie, rigueur et proactivité
• Esprit d'équipe et aisance relationnelle

Par la suite, vous aurez un entretien individuel avec un membre de notre équipe RH et le Responsable de la formation et réaliserez des tests théoriques et pratiques.

jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133495
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

WE WELCOME

We are looking for a talented Sales Associate who wants to join one of the legendary boutique, Cartier Lugano, and contribute to the success and growth of our boutique.

YOU WILL BE

An Ambassador of Cartier and will become your second nature in the Boutique and at external Client events. You will have the mission to deliver an outstanding service to high value guests while making them feel at home in our Boutique.

By proactively building a strong relationship with your Client’s portfolio, you will guide them across our Creations to deliver unique Client experience. Thanks to your team spirit, working towards individual targets as well as making a key difference to the shared team objectives will be your two main goals. Your contribution will be key to a seamless and smooth running of the Boutique operations.

The unique nature of our client's boutique means you have a realistic opportunity to deliver an amazing experience for guests. Our client can provide outstanding product training and development, but we need the passion, commitment and drive from you.

YOU ARE

Passionate and excel in understanding luxury client needs. You are delighted to cherish a true relationship with your Clients. As you will first join a team, you’re excited to create great energy with your team members. You will be welcomed by a friendly and open-minded and diverse team that focuses on providing an ultra-personal service. Each of them have unique skills, competencies and different background that you will learn from.

If you have a relevant experience of working in and succeeding in a Luxury Watch or Jewelry retail environment, you have a strong interpersonal and sales skills, you are a native Italian speaker, fluent in English & any other Swiss language is a plus and you have a positive energy, then this challenge will be perfect for you!

APPLY NOW IF YOU ARE THE UNIQUE TALENT WE ARE LOOKING FOR!

VOTRE MISSION

Assurer l'atteinte des objectifs de qualité, de délais, de coût, de sûreté et de sécurité en gérant son équipe et les moyens techniques utilisés.

CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS

Chez Cartier, vous intégrerez une communauté unie par un sens fort des responsabilités, où florissent connexion, collaboration et esprit collectif.

Nous valorisons l’individualité de nos talents, animés par un engagement commun envers l'excellence, inspirés par la diversité des cultures du monde, et attachés à respecter et enrichir notre héritage unique.

Rejoignez-nous chez Cartier, un lieu unique et en constante évolution.

A travers son histoire, Cartier s'est démarqué du fait de l'engagement de femmes et d'hommes singuliers. A ce titre, notre Maison offre à toutes et tous les mêmes opportunités d’accès à l’emploi, sans distinction notamment de genre, ethnicité, religion, orientation sexuelle, statut social, handicap et d’âge.

QUEL SERA VOTRE IMPACT ?

Assurer le management de votre équipe

•

jobs.title: Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133489
The story of Cartier is founded on curiosity and passion. For more than 170 years we have embraced a bold, pioneering spirit that continues to inspire our teams across all Métiers from our boutiques to our workshops and corporate offices. Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison’s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

CONTEXT

We are looking for a talented Sales Associate (12-month contract) who wants to join our team and contribute to the success and growth of one of our main boutiques.

YOU WILL BE

An Ambassador of Cartier and will become your second nature in the Boutique and at external Client events. You will have the mission to deliver an outstanding service to high value guests while making them feel at home in our Boutique.

By proactively building a strong relationship with your client’s portfolio, you will guide them across our Creations to deliver unique Client experience. Thanks to your team spirit, working towards individual targets as well as making a key difference to the shared team objectives will be your two main goals. Your contribution will be key to a seamless and smooth running of the Boutique operations.

The unique nature of our client's boutique means you have a realistic opportunity to deliver an amazing experience for guests. Our client can provide outstanding product training and development, but we need the passion, commitment and drive from you.

YOU ARE

Passionate and excel in understanding luxury client needs. You are delighted to cherish a true relationship with your clients. As you will first join a team, you’re excited to create great energy with your team members. You will be welcomed by a friendly and open-minded and diverse team that focuses on providing an ultra-personal service. Each of them have unique skills, competencies and different background that you will learn from.

If you have a relevant experience of working in and succeeding in a Luxury Watch or Jewelry retail environment, you have a strong interpersonal and sales skills, you speak fluently French & English and you have a positive energy, then this challenge will be perfect for you!

APPLY NOW IF YOU ARE THE UNIQUE TALENT WE ARE LOOKING FOR!

jobs.title: Mergers & Acquisitions Intern
jobs.description:
Reference code: JR133524

Richemont owns some of the world’s leading luxury goods Maisons, with particular strengths in jewellery, fine watches and premium accessories. Each Maison represents a proud tradition of style, quality and craftsmanship and Richemont seeks to preserve the heritage and identity of each of its Maisons. At the same time, we are committed to innovation and designing new products which are in keeping with our Maisons’ values, through a process of continuous creativity.

At Richemont, we craft the future. Our unique portfolio includes prestigious Maisons distinguished by their craftsmanship and creativity, alongside Online Distributors that cultivate expert curation and technological innovation to deliver the highest standards of service. Richemont’s ambition is to nurture its Maisons and businesses and enable them to grow and prosper in a responsible, sustainable manner over the long term.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) Department, supports the Group in the execution of key corporate development projects, including, among others, joint ventures, equity transactions, acquisitions, mergers and disposals, as well as related post-merger integration processes.

We are looking for a highly motivated individual to fill a 6-month internship position with start date 04.01.2027.

In line with this, your responsibilities would include:

• Support the M&A team in the review of potential investment opportunities: preparation of company profiles as well as investment memos to inform go/no-go decisions
• Assist the M&A team in financial and valuation analysis depending on deal type and stage of target’s development
• Assist in the management of key M&A and integration projects (organisation of key meetings, preparation of related materials and analysis, etc.)
• Contribute to the consolidation and management of the proprietary intelligence resources, including regular updates of transaction and trading comparable multiples
• Monitor relevant M&A news, market insights or competitors updates in the luxury goods space, preparing relevant alerts and updates for the management
• Attend relevant meetings, take minutes and ensure that follow-up actions are completed

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• You are a Master’s student in a Business school or university, with a specialisation in Finance, Business Administration or Management (minimum GPA 3.65/4 or equivalent)
• You have strong analytical and numerical skills, including some knowledge of corporate finance and valuation
• You are highly motivated and proactive with excellent communication skills
• You are a team player
• You are rigorous, reliable and pay attention to details
• You have some knowledge and a strong interest in the luxury goods industry
• You are proficient in Microsoft office programs
• You are fluent in English
• Previous internship experience in finance to be considered a strong plus
• Highly discreet - absolute trust and confidentiality required
• Internship agreement with your school/university mandatory

YOUR JOURNEY WITH US:

If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call. As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency, namely, you will have the chance to meet the people who will be crucial to your future success in the role.

#Richemont #WeCraftTheFuture

Integration of Enboarder with different systems

IT contact for the Enboarder project Team
